en.t: Lothair I is crowned King of Italy by Pope Paschal I
en.s: Lothair I (Frankish: Ludher and Medieval Latin: Lodharius; Dutch and Medieval Latin: Lotharius; German: Lothar; French: Lothaire; Italian: Lotario; 795 – 29 September 855) was a 9th-century Emperor of the Carolingian Empire (817–855, with his father until 840) and King of Italy (818–855) and Middle Francia (843–855). Lothair I was the eldest son of the Carolingian emperor Louis I and his wife Ermengarde of Hesbaye, daughter of Ingerman the duke of Hesbaye.

zh.t: 洛泰尔一世在罗马加冕
zh.s: 823年4月5日，教皇帕斯卡尔一世在罗马再次为洛泰尔一世举行皇帝加冕礼。洛泰尔约生于795年、逝于855年，是加洛林帝国皇帝（817年至855年，840年前与父亲共治）、意大利国王（818年至855年）及中法兰克国王（843年至855年）；其父为皇帝虔诚者路易，母为埃斯拜的埃尔芒加德。

en.s: The second Fatimid invasion of Egypt occurred in 919–921, following the failure of the first attempt in 914–915. The expedition was again commanded by the Fatimid Caliphate's heir-apparent, al-Qa'im bi-Amr Allah. As during the previous attempt, the Fatimids captured Alexandria with ease. However, while the Abbasid garrison in Fustat was weaker and mutinous due to lack of pay, al-Qa'im did not exploit it for an immediate attack on the city, such as the one that had failed in 914.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 法蒂玛王朝入侵埃及（919—921年）
zh.s: 第二次法蒂玛王朝入侵埃及发生于919至921年，此前法蒂玛王朝曾于914至915年入侵但未能成功。这次远征仍由法蒂玛王朝继承人卡伊姆·比阿姆里拉指挥。与上次一样，法蒂玛军队轻易攻占亚历山大港。但尽管富斯塔特的阿拔斯驻军兵力较弱、又因欠饷而发生兵变，卡伊姆仍未立即进攻该城；此前914年的进攻正是以失败告终。

en.s: The Battle on the Ice, also known as the Battle of Lake Peipus, took place on 5 April 1242. It was fought on the frozen Lake Peipus when the united forces of the Republic of Novgorod and Vladimir-Suzdal (also referred to by the proper noun as simply Vladimir), led by Prince Alexander Nevsky, emerged victorious against the forces of the Livonian Order and Bishopric of Dorpat, led by Bishop Hermann of Dorpat.

zh.s: 冰湖之战又称楚德湖之战，发生于1242年4月5日。战斗在冰封的楚德湖上进行，由亚历山大·涅夫斯基亲自率领的诺夫哥罗德共和国与弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔联军，击败了多尔帕特主教赫尔曼率领的利沃尼亚骑士团和多尔帕特主教区军队。

en.s: The Battle of Northampton took place during the Second Barons' War. The battle was a decisive victory for the royalist forces of King Henry III of England, who took Northampton Castle and captured Simon de Montfort (the Younger), son of Simon de Montfort (the Older).

zh.s: 北安普敦战役发生于第二次男爵战争期间。英格兰国王亨利三世的保王党军队取得决定性胜利，攻占北安普敦城堡，并俘虏了西蒙·德·蒙福特（小），也就是西蒙·德·蒙福特（大）的儿子。

en.s: The War in Gotland (1398), also called the Gotland campaign of the Teutonic Knights was an invasion to the island of Gotland in 1398 by the Teutonic Order. In the 1390s, Gotland was engulfed in the turmoil of the ongoing war between the Mecklenburgs and Margaret I. This conflict made the Baltic Sea a haven for pirates, the Victual Brothers and various raiders.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1398年的哥特兰战争又称条顿骑士团哥特兰战役，是条顿骑士团于1398年入侵哥特兰岛的一场战争。1390年代，梅克伦堡家族与玛格丽特一世之间的战争蔓延至哥特兰岛。波罗的海因此成为维克托兄弟会等海盗和劫掠者的活动场所。

en.s: The free election of 1573 was the first ever royal election to be held in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. It attracted an estimated 40,000–50,000 szlachta (Polish nobility) voters (the highest turnout ever) who elected Henry of Valois king. The free election was introduced due to the childless death of the last Jagiellonian monarch Sigismund II Augustus and the lack of a potential candidate that would satisfy most of the nobles.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1573年的自由选举是波兰-立陶宛联邦首次举行的王室选举。据估计，有40,000至50,000名波兰贵族（szlachta）参加投票，投票率创下历史最高纪录，亨利·德·瓦卢瓦当选国王。这项自由选举制度的设立，源于最后一位雅盖隆王朝君主齐格蒙特二世·奥古斯特无嗣去世，且没有合适的候选人能获得大多数贵族认可。

en.t: The second English Parliament of king James I, the so-called Addled Parliament, opens
en.s: The Parliament of 1614 was the second Parliament of England of the reign of James VI and I and sat between 5 April and 7 June 1614. Lasting only two months and two days, it saw no bills pass and was not even regarded as a parliament by contemporaries. However, for its failure it has been known to posterity as the Addled Parliament.

zh.t: 詹姆斯一世时期第二届英格兰议会（“愚蠢议会”）开会
zh.s: 1614年议会是英格兰国王詹姆斯六世及一世在位期间召开的第二届议会，于1614年4月5日至6月7日开会。议会只持续两个月零两天，没有通过任何法案，当时甚至有人不把它视为正式议会。由于毫无成果，后世称它为“愚蠢议会”。

en.s: The 1780 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1780, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Independent governor William Greene won re-election as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1780年4月5日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。独立派现任州长威廉·格林因无竞争对手而连任。具体票数已不可考。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Massachusetts on April 5, 1784. John Hancock, the incumbent governor, was re-elected, with only token opposition.

zh.s: 1784年4月5日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。现任州长约翰·汉考克仅面对象征性竞争，成功连任。

en.s: The 1786 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1786, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Independent candidate and former Delegate to the Continental Congress from Rhode Island John Collins defeated incumbent Independent governor William Greene. The exact number of votes cast in this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1786年4月5日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。独立候选人、曾代表本州参加大陆会议的约翰·柯林斯，击败同为独立派的现任州长威廉·格林。具体票数已不可考。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Massachusetts on April 5, 1790. John Hancock, the incumbent governor, defeated James Bowdoin, who had served as the second governor of Massachusetts from 1785 to 1787.

zh.s: 1790年4月5日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。现任州长约翰·汉考克击败詹姆斯·鲍登，后者曾于1785年至1787年担任该州第二任州长。

en.t: United States President George Washington exercises his authority to veto a bill, the first time this power is used in the United States
en.s: George Washington (February 22, 1732 [O.S. February 11, 1731] – December 14, 1799) was a Founding Father and the first president of the United States, serving from 1789 to 1797. As commander of the Continental Army, Washington led Patriot forces to victory in the American Revolutionary War against the British Empire. He is commonly known as the Father of His Country for his role in bringing about American independence.

zh.t: 美国总统乔治·华盛顿首次行使总统否决权，否决一项法案
zh.s: 乔治·华盛顿（1732年2月22日〔旧历1731年2月11日〕—1799年12月14日）是美国开国元勋和首任总统，1789年至1797年在任。作为大陆军司令，华盛顿率领爱国者军队在美国独立战争中击败大英帝国。他因在实现美国独立过程中发挥的作用，常被称为“国父”。

en.s: The 1797 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1797, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Arthur Fenner won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1797年4月5日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。民主共和党现任州长阿瑟·芬纳因无竞争对手而连任。

en.s: In the Battle of Magnano on 5 April 1799, an Austrian army commanded by Pál Kray defeated a French army led by Barthélemy Schérer. In subsequent battles, the Austrians and their Russian allies drove the French out of nearly all of Italy. This action was fought during the War of the Second Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars.

zh.s: 1799年4月5日，帕尔·克赖指挥的奥地利军，在马尼亚诺战役中击败巴泰勒米·舍雷尔率领的法军。随后一系列战斗中，奥军及其俄罗斯盟军将法军逐出意大利几乎全部地区。此役属于法国大革命战争中的第二次反法同盟战争。

en.s: The Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36, is a symphony in four movements written by Ludwig van Beethoven between 1801 and 1802. The work is dedicated to Karl Alois, Prince Lichnowsky.

zh.s: 《D大调第二交响曲，作品36号》是路德维希·凡·贝多芬于1801年至1802年创作的一部四乐章交响曲。作品题献给卡尔·阿洛伊斯·利希诺夫斯基亲王。

zh.s: 1809年4月5日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。民主共和党现任州长詹姆斯·芬纳因无竞争对手而连任。具体票数已不可考。

en.s: The Battle of Manresa and Battle of Vilafranca from 21 March to 5 April 1810 saw a Spanish division led by Juan Caro and Luis González Torres de Navarra, Marquess of Campoverde attack an Imperial French brigade commanded by François Xavier de Schwarz.

en.s: The 1813 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1813, in order to elect the Governor of Massachusetts. Incumbent Federalist Governor Caleb Strong won re-election against Democratic-Republican candidate and incumbent United States Senator from Massachusetts Joseph Bradley Varnum.

zh.s: 1813年4月5日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。联邦党现任州长凯莱布·斯特朗，击败民主共和党候选人、时任本州联邦参议员约瑟夫·布拉德利·瓦纳姆，成功连任。

en.s: The Battle of Möckern (also known as the Battle of Dannigkow) was a series of heavy clashes between allied Prusso-Russian troops under Russian commander Peter Wittgenstein and Napoleonic French forces under Eugène de Beauharnais south of Möckern. It occurred on 5 April 1813. It ended in a French defeat and formed the successful prelude to the "Liberation War" against Napoleon (the German name for the German theatre of the War of the Sixth Coalition).

zh.s: 默克恩战役又称丹尼科战役，是1813年4月5日在默克恩以南发生的一系列激战。俄军指挥官彼得·维特根施泰因率领普鲁士和俄罗斯联军，对阵欧根·德·博阿尔内指挥的拿破仑法军。法军战败，此战也为随后反抗拿破仑的“解放战争”（第六次反法同盟战争中的德意志战场）打下了胜利的基础。

en.t: On 5 April 1815, a giant eruption occurred, followed by thunderous detonation sounds heard in Makassar on Sulawesi away, Batavia (now Jakarta) on Java away, and Ternate on the Molucca Islands away
en.s: In April 1815, Mount Tambora, a volcano on the island of Sumbawa in present-day Indonesia (then part of the Dutch East Indies), erupted in what is now considered the most powerful volcanic eruption in recorded human history. This eruption, with a volcanic explosivity index (VEI) of 7, ejected 37–45 km3 (8.9–10.8 cubic miles) of dense-rock equivalent (DRE) material into the atmosphere, and was the most recent confirmed VEI-7 eruption.

zh.s: 1815年4月，位于松巴哇岛（今属印度尼西亚，当时为荷属东印度）上的坦博拉火山爆发。这次喷发的火山爆发指数（VEI）为7，被认为是人类有记录以来威力最大的火山喷发。喷发物致密岩石当量达37至45立方千米（8.9至10.8立方英里），也是最近一次得到确认的VEI-7级喷发。

en.s: The Battle of Maipú (Spanish: Batalla de Maipú) was a battle fought near Santiago, Chile on April 5, 1818 between South American rebels and Spanish royalists, during the Chilean War of Independence. The Patriot rebels led by argentine general José de San Martín effectively destroyed the Spanish forces commanded by General Mariano Osorio, and completed the independence of the core area of Chile from Spanish domination.

zh.s: 1818年4月5日，智利独立战争期间，南美起义军与西班牙保王军在智利圣地亚哥附近的迈普交战。阿根廷将军何塞·德·圣马丁率领的爱国派起义军，基本摧毁马里亚诺·奥索里奥将军指挥的西班牙军，完成了智利核心地区摆脱西班牙统治的独立进程。

en.s: The 1819 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1819, in order to elect the Governor of Massachusetts. Incumbent Federalist Governor John Brooks won re-election against Democratic-Republican candidate and former United States Secretary of the Navy Benjamin Williams Crowninshield in a rematch of the previous election.

zh.s: 1819年4月5日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。联邦党现任州长约翰·布鲁克斯，再次击败上届对手、民主共和党候选人及前美国海军部长本杰明·威廉斯·克劳宁希尔德，成功连任。

en.s: The Ochomogo War was a civil war fought in Costa Rica, the first in its history, and was fought shortly after the country became independent from Spain. The most important event was the Battle of Ochomogo (5 April 1823) which was fought on Ochomogo Hill, from which it takes it name, to the west of Cartago, Costa Rica.

zh.s: 奥乔莫戈战争是哥斯达黎加历史上的首次内战，发生在该国脱离西班牙独立后不久。最重要的战斗为1823年4月5日的奥乔莫戈战役，地点在卡塔戈以西的奥乔莫戈山，战争也因此得名。

en.s: The 1824 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 5. Democratic-Republican Governor William Eustis was re-elected to a second term in office over U.S. Representative Samuel Lathrop, a Federalist ally of John Quincy Adams. This was the last election in which the dying Federalist Party, which had already collapsed at the national level, was competitive.

zh.s: 1824年马萨诸塞州州长选举于4月5日举行。民主共和党籍州长威廉·尤斯蒂斯击败联邦党人、联邦众议员塞缪尔·拉思罗普，连任第二个任期。这是已经在全国层面瓦解、日渐衰落的联邦党仍有竞争力的最后一次选举。

en.s: The 1830 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 5. National Republican Governor Levi Lincoln Jr. was re-elected to a sixth term in office over Democrat Marcus Morton.

zh.s: 1830年马萨诸塞州州长选举于4月5日举行。国民共和党籍州长利瓦伊·林肯二世击败民主党候选人马库斯·莫顿，连任第六个任期。

en.s: The 1841 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1841. Incumbent governor and Whig nominee William W. Ellsworth was re-elected, defeating businessman and Democratic nominee Francis H. Nicoll with 55.79% of the vote. This was the largest percentage of the vote achieved by the Whig Party in a Connecticut election for governor. Nicoll had made his fortune in New York City, and moved back to his home town of Stafford some time before 1841.

zh.s: 1841年4月5日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。辉格党现任州长威廉·W.埃尔斯沃思，以55.79%的得票率击败民主党候选人、商人弗朗西斯·H.尼科尔，成功连任。这是辉格党在该州州长选举中的最高得票率。尼科尔曾在纽约市经商致富，并于1841年前不久迁回故乡斯塔福德。

en.s: The 1843 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1843, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Law and Order nominee and former governor James Fenner defeated Democratic nominee Thomas F. Carpenter.

zh.s: 1843年4月5日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。法律与秩序党候选人、前州长詹姆斯·芬纳，击败民主党候选人托马斯·F.卡彭特。

en.s: The 1847 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1847. Former state legislator and Whig nominee Clark Bissell was elected, defeating Democratic nominee Isaac Whittlesey with 50.54% of the vote.

zh.s: 1847年4月5日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。辉格党候选人、前州议员克拉克·比塞尔，以50.54%的得票率击败民主党候选人艾萨克·惠特尔西。

en.s: The 1848 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1848. Incumbent Whig governor Elisha Harris won re-election to a second term, defeating Democratic nominee Adnah Sackett.

zh.s: 1848年4月5日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。辉格党现任州长伊莱沙·哈里斯击败民主党候选人阿德纳·萨克特，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The Battle of Eckernförde was a Danish naval assault on Schleswig. The Danes were defeated and two of their ships were lost, with the surviving crew being detained.

zh.s: 埃克恩弗德海战是丹麦海军对石勒苏益格发起的攻击。丹麦军队战败，两艘舰船被毁，幸存船员被扣押。

en.s: The 1852 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1852. Incumbent governor and Democratic Party nominee Thomas H. Seymour defeated incumbent Lieutenant Governor and Whig nominee Green Kendrick with 50.39% of the vote.

zh.s: 1852年4月5日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。民主党现任州长托马斯·H.西摩，以50.39%的得票率击败辉格党候选人、现任副州长格林·肯德里克。

en.s: The 1854 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1854, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Democratic governor Francis M. Dimond was defeated by Whig nominee William W. Hoppin.

zh.s: 1854年4月5日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。民主党现任州长弗朗西斯·M.戴蒙德，被辉格党候选人威廉·W.霍平击败。

en.s: The 1856 Dallas mayoral election was the first mayoral election in Dallas, Texas. The election was held on April 5, 1856. In the election, Dr. Samuel B. Pryor defeated challenger and eventual mayor A. D. Rice.

zh.s: 1856年4月5日，美国得克萨斯州达拉斯举行首次市长选举。塞缪尔·B.普赖尔医生击败挑战者A.D.赖斯，后者后来也担任过市长。

en.s: The 1858 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1858. Former Norwich mayor and Republican nominee William Alfred Buckingham defeated former congressman and Democratic nominee James T. Pratt with 51.97% of the vote.

zh.s: 1858年4月5日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。共和党候选人、前诺里奇市长威廉·阿尔弗雷德·白金汉，以51.97%的得票率击败民主党候选人、前国会议员詹姆斯·T.普拉特。

en.s: The Siege of Jhansi was a military siege during the Indian rebellion of 1857 set on the city of Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh by British forces of the East India Company between 24 March and 5 April 1858. British defeated the combined forces of the Principality of Jhansi and anti-British mutineers defending the city, successfully continuing in their Central Indian campaign.

zh.s: 占西围城战是1857年印度起义期间的一场围城战。1858年3月24日至4月5日，英国东印度公司的军队围攻北方邦占西城。英军击败了占西土邦军队和反英起义者组成的联军，成功推进了在印度中部的军事行动。

en.s: The 1859 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on Tuesday, April 5, 1859, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a full term. Byron Paine was elected to succeed Abram D. Smith.

zh.t: 1859年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1859年威斯康星州最高法院选举于4月5日星期二举行，选出一名最高法院法官，任期完整。拜伦·佩恩当选，接替亚伯拉姆·D·史密斯。

en.t: American Civil War: The Battle of Yorktown begins
en.s: The American Civil War (April 12, 1861 – May 26, 1865; also known by other names) was a civil war in the United States between the Union ("the North") and the Confederacy ("the South"), which was formed in 1861 by Southern states that had seceded from the Union to preserve slavery in the United States.

zh.t: 美国内战：约克镇战役开始
zh.s: 美国内战（1861年4月12日—1865年5月26日；另有其他称呼）是美国联邦（“北方”）与邦联（“南方”）之间的内战。邦联于1861年由脱离联邦的南方各州组成，目的是维护美国的奴隶制度。

en.s: General elections were held in Costa Rica on 5 April 1863 to elect the president for a three-year term. Incumbent José María Montealegre was constitutionally barred from seeking immediate re-election. Former First Designate Jesús Jiménez Zamora was elected with 98.7% of the electoral vote, becoming the first president from Cartago Province and the second physician to hold the office.

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于1863年4月5日举行大选，选出任期三年的总统。现任何塞·玛丽亚·蒙特阿莱格雷按宪法不得立即连任。曾任第一指定继任人的赫苏斯·希门尼斯·萨莫拉，以98.7%的选举人票当选，成为首位来自卡塔戈省的总统，也是第二位担任该职的医生。

loc: 美国弗吉尼亚州阿米利亚县

en.s: The Battle of Amelia Springs, Virginia was an engagement between the Union Army (Army of the Shenandoah, Army of the Potomac and Army of the James) and Confederate Army of Northern Virginia that occurred on April 5, 1865 during the Appomattox Campaign of the American Civil War. It was followed by a second rear guard action near the same location on the night of April 5, 1865 and morning of April 6, 1865 during the Union Army pursuit of the Confederate forces (Army of Northern Virginia and Richmond local defense forces) which were fleeing westward after the fall of Petersburg and Richmond, Virginia at the Third Battle of Petersburg (sometimes shown as the Breakthrough at Petersburg) on April 2, 1865.

zh.s: 1865年4月5日，美国南北战争的阿波马托克斯战役期间，联邦军与北弗吉尼亚邦联军在弗吉尼亚州阿米利亚温泉交战。联邦军包括谢南多厄、波托马克和詹姆斯三个军团。4月2日第三次彼得斯堡战役（又称彼得斯堡突破战）后，彼得斯堡和里士满失守，北弗吉尼亚军及里士满地方防卫部队向西撤退，联邦军追击。4月5日夜至6日早晨，同一地点附近又发生第二次后卫战斗。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Rhode Island on April 5, 1865. The National Union incumbent governor James Y. Smith was re-elected against token opposition. Smith, a Radical Republican, won the 1863 Rhode Island gubernatorial election and was re-elected in 1864. His nearest opponent was the former state senator Edward Harris, an abolitionist and temperance supporter who ran on the Equal Rights ticket.

zh.s: 1865年4月5日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。全国联盟党现任州长詹姆斯·Y.史密斯，仅面对象征性竞争而连任。身为激进共和党人的史密斯于1863年首次当选，1864年连任。此次主要对手为前州参议员爱德华·哈里斯，他支持废奴和禁酒，以平等权利派名义参选。

en.s: The 1869 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1869. It was a rematch of the 1868 Connecticut gubernatorial election. Republican nominee Marshall Jewell defeated incumbent governor and Democratic nominee James E. English with 50.22% of the vote.

zh.s: 1869年4月5日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举，上届两名候选人再次竞争。共和党候选人马歇尔·朱厄尔，以50.22%的得票率击败民主党现任州长詹姆斯·E.英格利希。

en.s: The 1875 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1875. Incumbent governor and Democratic nominee Charles R. Ingersoll defeated Republican nominee J. Greene with 53.23% of the vote. This was the last gubernatorial election to elect the governor of Connecticut to a term of one year, from May 7, 1875, to May 7, 1876.

zh.s: 1875年4月5日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。民主党现任州长查尔斯·R.英格索尔，以53.23%的得票率击败共和党候选人J.格林。这是该州最后一次选出一年任期州长，任期从1875年5月7日至1876年5月7日。

en.s: The 1876 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1876. Incumbent Republican governor Henry Lippitt defeated Prohibition Party nominee Albert C. Howard and Democratic nominee William B. Beach. Since no candidate received a majority in the popular vote, Lippitt was elected by the Rhode Island General Assembly per the state constitution.

zh.s: 1876年4月5日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。共和党现任州长亨利·利皮特，击败禁酒党候选人阿尔伯特·C.霍华德和民主党候选人威廉·B.比奇。由于无人取得过半数普选票，依照州宪法，最终由州议会选出利皮特继续任职。

en.s: The Blockade of Iquique was a military operation that occurred during the War of the Pacific. Once war was declared by Chile upon Peru on Saturday, April 5, 1879, the first Chilean naval action for the War of the Pacific was set in motion. The plan was to block the Peruvian port of Iquique the same day the declaration of war was made.

zh.s: 伊基克封锁是硝石战争中的一项军事行动。1879年4月5日星期六，智利向秘鲁宣战，随即启动这场战争中的首次海军行动，计划在宣战当天封锁当时属于秘鲁的伊基克港。

en.s: The Chicago mayoral election of 1881 was held on April 5, saw the incumbent mayor, Democrat Carter Harrison III, defeat Republican Candidate John M. Clark. Harrison won a majority of the vote with a nearly twelve point margin of victory. The election took place on April 5. Unlike in the previous mayoral election, the Socialist Labor Party's nominee did not have much of an impact.

zh.s: 1881年芝加哥市长选举于4月5日举行。现任民主党市长卡特·哈里森三世击败共和党候选人约翰·M·克拉克。哈里森以多数票获胜，领先近12个百分点。与上一次市长选举不同，社会主义工党候选人此次影响不大。

en.s: The 1882 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1882. Incumbent Republican Alfred H. Littlefield defeated Democratic nominee Horace A. Kimball with 64.78% of the vote.

zh.s: 1882年4月5日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。共和党现任州长阿尔弗雷德·H.利特尔菲尔德，以64.78%的得票率击败民主党候选人霍勒斯·A.金博尔。

en.s: The Chicago mayoral election of 1887 saw Republican John A. Roche win by a landslide, receiving more than a two-thirds majority of the vote, defeating United Labor Party nominee Robert S. Nelson by more than 36 points (a margin of victory which was itself greater than Nelson's vote share), in a race where the Democratic Party had failed to field a candidate.

zh.s: 1887年芝加哥市长选举中，共和党人约翰·A·罗奇以压倒性优势获胜，得票超过三分之二。他击败了联合劳工党候选人罗伯特·S·纳尔逊，领先幅度超过36个百分点；这场选举中民主党没有提名候选人。

en.s: The 1893 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1893. Incumbent Republican Daniel Russell Brown defeated Democratic nominee David S. Baker with 46.34% of the vote.

zh.s: 1893年4月5日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。共和党现任州长丹尼尔·拉塞尔·布朗，以46.34%的得票率击败民主党候选人戴维·S.贝克。

en.s: An election for Mayor of Milwaukee was held on April 5, 1898. David S. Rose was elected with 56% of the vote. Candidates included Democratic-Populist attorney David S. Rose, Republican businessman William Geuder, and Social Democrat Robert Meister.

zh.s: 密尔沃基市长选举于1898年4月5日举行。戴维·S·罗斯以56%的选票当选。候选人包括民主党-民粹党律师罗斯、共和党商人威廉·盖德和社会民主党人罗伯特·迈斯特。

en.s: The 1899 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 5, 1899. Incumbent Republican Elisha Dyer Jr. defeated Democratic nominee George W. Greene with 56.36% of the vote.

zh.s: 1899年4月5日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。共和党现任州长小伊莱沙·戴尔，以56.36%的得票率击败民主党候选人乔治·W.格林。

en.s: The Battle of Boshof was fought during the Second Boer War on 5 April 1900 between British forces and mostly French volunteers of the Boer army.

zh.s: 博肖夫战役于1900年4月5日在第二次布尔战争期间打响，交战双方是英国军队和布尔军中以法国志愿兵为主的部队。

en.s: The 1902 Ibrox disaster was the collapse of a stand at Ibrox Park (now Ibrox Stadium) in Govan (now part of Glasgow), Scotland. The collapse caused the deaths of 25 supporters, and injuries to 500 more during an international association football match between Scotland and England on 5 April 1902 as part of the 1901–02 British Home Championship. Ibrox Park had completed construction less than three years before the incident and was hosting its first international fixture, with the crowd estimated to be over 68,000. The match was the first time that the ground had been used at more than half capacity since its opening.

zh.s: 1902年4月5日，苏格兰与英格兰在1901—1902赛季英国本土锦标赛中交锋时，位于戈万的埃布罗克斯公园球场看台坍塌，造成25名球迷死亡、约500人受伤。戈万如今属于格拉斯哥，场地现称埃布罗克斯体育场。当时球场建成不足三年，首次举办国际比赛，估计有超过6.8万名观众。这也是球场开放以来，观众人数首次超过容量的一半。

en.s: An election for Mayor of Milwaukee was held on April 5, 1904. Incumbent mayor David S. Rose was re-elected with 40% of the vote. Candidates included incumbent mayor David S. Rose, Milwaukee County prosecuting attorney Guy D. Goff, Vorwärts! editor Victor L. Berger, and Socialist Laborite Frank Wilke.

zh.s: 密尔沃基市长选举于1904年4月5日举行。现任市长戴维·S·罗斯以40%的选票连任。候选人包括罗斯、密尔沃基县检察官盖伊·D·戈夫、《前进报》编辑维克托·L·伯格，以及社会主义工党候选人弗兰克·威尔克。

en.s: The 1905 Brighton by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 5 April 1905. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system. It was one of only eight ministerial by-elections in the UK not to be retained by the incumbent.

zh.s: 1905年4月5日，英国布赖顿选区举行议会补选，以得票领先者当选制选出一名下议院议员。在英国因议员出任部长而须重新参选的补选中，只有八次现任者未能保住席位，此次便是其中之一。

en.s: The 1904 Dallas mayoral election was a mayoral election in Dallas, Texas, held alongside municipal elections. The election was held on April 5, 1905. In this election Bryan T. Barry won against an unknown candidate.

zh.s: 这次美国得克萨斯州达拉斯市长选举，与市政选举同时进行，布赖恩·T.巴里击败一名姓名不详的候选人。原文标题标为1904年，但正文记载投票日期为1905年4月5日。

en.s: The Peasant Uprising of 1907 (Romanian: Răscoala țărănească din 1907) took place in Romania between 21 February and 5 April 1907. It started in northern Moldavia and, after three weeks in which it was localized in that area, it quickly spread, reaching Wallachia, including as far as Oltenia. The main cause was the discontent of the peasants over the inequity of land ownership, which was mostly in the hands of just a few large landowners.

zh.s: 1907年2月21日至4月5日，罗马尼亚爆发农民起义。起义从摩尔达维亚北部开始，前三周局限于当地，随后迅速蔓延至瓦拉几亚，最远达到奥尔特尼亚。主要原因是农民不满土地所有权分配不公，大部分土地集中在少数大地主手中。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 5 April 1908. The Regeneration Party emerged as the largest party in Parliament, winning 62 seats.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1908年4月5日举行议会选举。复兴党赢得62席，成为议会第一大党。

en.s: An election for Mayor of Milwaukee was held on April 5, 1910. Emil Seidel was elected with 46% of the vote. He was sworn in on April 19, 1910. Candidates included Milwaukee city alderman Emil Seidel, Milwaukee city comptroller Vincenz J. Schoenecker, and physician John M. Beffel.

zh.s: 密尔沃基市长选举于1910年4月5日举行。埃米尔·塞德尔以46%的选票当选，并于1910年4月19日宣誓就职。候选人包括密尔沃基市议员塞德尔、市财务审计官文森茨·J·舍内克和医生约翰·M·贝费尔。

en.t: The Transandine Railway connecting Chile and Argentina is inaugurated
en.s: The Transandine Railway (Spanish: Ferrocarril Trasandino) was a 1,000 mm (3 ft 3+3⁄8 in) metre gauge combined rack (Abt system) and adhesion railway which operated from Mendoza in Argentina, across the Andes mountain range via the Uspallata Pass, to Santa Rosa de Los Andes in Chile, a distance of 248 km. It was a part of the first rail route linking the southern Pacific and Atlantic Oceans.

zh.t: 连接智利和阿根廷的跨安第斯铁路通车
zh.s: 跨安第斯铁路（西班牙语：Ferrocarril Trasandino）是铁路轨距为1,000毫米（3英尺3又3/8英寸）的米轨铁路，结合齿轨（阿布特系统）和普通黏着式轨道。铁路从阿根廷门多萨出发，经乌斯帕亚塔山口穿越安第斯山脉，抵达智利圣罗莎-德洛斯安第斯，全长248公里。它是首条连接南太平洋和南大西洋的铁路路线的一部分。

en.s: The Second Battle of Dernancourt, known to the Germans as Unternehmen Sonnenschein (Operation Sunshine), was fought on 5 April 1918 near Dernancourt in northern France during World War I. It involved a German Army force attacking an Australian defending force, and resulted in the German capture of much of the forward sector of the Australian front line which ran along a railway line between Albert and Dernancourt.

zh.t: 第二次德尔南库尔战役
zh.s: 1918年4月5日，第一次世界大战期间，德军在法国北部德尔南库尔附近进攻澳大利亚守军。德方称此次行动为“阳光行动”。战斗中，德军夺取了澳军沿阿尔贝至德尔南库尔铁路线部署的大部分前沿阵地。

en.s: The Battle of the Avre (4–5 April 1918), part of the First Battle of Villers-Bretonneux, constituted the final German attack towards Amiens in World War I. It was the point at which the Germans got the closest to Amiens. It was fought between attacking German troops and defending Australian and British troops. The attack was an attempt to take Amiens, where other aspects of Operation Michael had failed.

zh.s: 阿弗尔河战役发生于1918年4月4日至5日，是维莱-布勒托讷第一次战役的一部分，也是第一次世界大战中德军向亚眠发起的最后一次进攻。德军在此战中最接近亚眠。交战双方是进攻的德军和防守的澳大利亚、英国军队。德军试图夺取亚眠，此前“迈克尔行动”的其他攻势未能达成这一目标。

en.s: The First Battle of Villers-Bretonneux (30 March – 5 April 1918), took place during Operation Michael, part of the German spring offensive on the Western Front. The offensive began against the British Fifth Army and the Third Army on the Somme and pushed back the British and French reinforcements on the north side of the Somme.

zh.t: 维莱-布勒托讷第一次战役
zh.s: 维莱-布勒托讷第一次战役发生于1918年3月30日至4月5日，是“迈克尔行动”的一部分；“迈克尔行动”属于德军在西线发动的春季攻势。攻势从索姆河一线开始，德军进攻英国第五集团军和第三集团军，并将英国和法国增援部队从索姆河北岸击退。

en.s: The Battle of Rautu was a 1918 Finnish Civil War battle, fought in Rautu, Finland (now Sosnovo, Leningrad Oblast, Russia) from 21 February to 5 April 1918 between the Finnish Whites and the Finnish Reds supported by the Russian Bolsheviks. The battle was fought by the Rautu railway station, taken by the Reds in late February and soon sieged by the Whites.

zh.s: 劳图战役是1918年芬兰内战期间的一场战斗，1918年2月21日至4月5日在芬兰劳图（今俄罗斯列宁格勒州索斯诺沃）进行，交战双方是芬兰白军、芬兰红军及支持红军的俄罗斯布尔什维克。战斗发生在劳图火车站一带。红军于2月下旬占领该站，不久后白军便开始围困。

en.s: Operation Michael (German: Unternehmen Michael) was a major German military offensive during World War I that began the German spring offensive on 21 March 1918. It was launched from the Hindenburg Line, in the vicinity of Saint-Quentin, France. Its goal was to break through the Allied (Entente) lines and advance in a north-westerly direction to seize the Channel Ports, which supplied the British Expeditionary Force (BEF), and to drive the BEF into the sea, all before the Americans could arrive in full numbers to turn the tide of the war.

zh.s: 迈克尔行动（德语：Unternehmen Michael）是第一次世界大战期间德军发动的一次大型军事攻势，也是德军1918年春季攻势的开端。行动于1918年3月21日开始，从法国圣康坦附近的兴登堡防线发起。德军计划突破协约国防线，向西北推进，占领为英国远征军提供补给的英吉利海峡港口，并将远征军逼入海中，赶在美国大批部队抵达、扭转战局之前完成目标。

en.s: The 1921 San Diego mayoral election was held on April 5, 1921, to elect the mayor for San Diego. In the primary election, former mayor James E. Wadham and former City Councilmember John L. Bacon received the most votes and advanced to the runoff. Bacon was then elected mayor with a majority of the votes.

zh.s: 1921年圣迭戈市长选举于4月5日举行。在初选中，前市长詹姆斯·E·沃德姆和前市议员约翰·L·培根得票领先，进入决选。培根随后以多数票当选市长。

en.s: State elections were held in South Australia on 5 April 1924. All 46 seats in the South Australian House of Assembly were up for election. The incumbent Liberal Federation government led by Premier of South Australia Henry Barwell was defeated by the opposition Australian Labor Party led by Leader of the Opposition John Gunn. Each district elected multiple members, with voters casting multiple votes.

zh.s: 南澳大利亚州选举于1924年4月5日举行，州议会众议院全部46个席位都进行改选。由州长亨利·巴韦尔领导的执政自由联盟政府败给了由反对党领袖约翰·冈领导的澳大利亚工党。每个选区选出多名议员，选民可以投多张选票。

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 5 April 1925. The result was a victory for the Belgian Labour Party, which won 78 of the 187 seats in the Chamber of Representatives. Voter turnout was 92.8% in the Chamber election and 92.7% in the Senate election. An extra seat in the Chamber of Representatives was assigned to the arrondissement of Verviers, after the annexation of Eupen-Malmedy.

zh.s: 比利时于1925年4月5日举行大选。比利时工人党赢得众议院187席中的78席，取得胜利。众议院选举投票率为92.8%，参议院为92.7%。吞并欧本—马尔梅迪后，韦尔维耶区获增一个众议院议席。

en.s: The 1927 Chicago mayoral election was held on April 5, 1927. Democratic incumbent William Emmett Dever was defeated by Republican candidate William Hale Thompson, who had served as mayor from 1915 to 1923. John Dill Robertson (the president West Parks Board, as well as former health commissioner and school board president), who had been previously allied with the ex-mayor, broke with Thompson to run on his own and received more than five percent of the vote.

zh.s: 1927年4月5日，芝加哥举行市长选举。民主党现任市长威廉·埃米特·德弗，被共和党候选人、曾于1915年至1923年任市长的威廉·黑尔·汤普森击败。西部公园委员会主席、前卫生专员及教育委员会主席约翰·迪尔·罗伯逊，原与汤普森结盟，但随后与他决裂并独立参选，取得超过5%的选票。

en.s: The 1927 San Diego mayoral election was held on April 5, 1927 to elect the mayor for San Diego. Incumbent mayor John L. Bacon did not to stand for reelection. In the primary election, Harry C. Clark and Percy J. Benbough received the most votes and advanced to a runoff election. Clark was then elected mayor with a majority of the votes in the runoff.

zh.s: 1927年圣迭戈市长选举于4月5日举行。现任市长约翰·L·培根没有竞选连任。初选中，哈里·C·克拉克和珀西·J·本博夫得票领先，进入决选。克拉克随后在决选中以多数票当选。

en.s: The 1927 Chicago aldermanic election happened on February 22 to elect the 50 aldermen of the Chicago City Council, on the same day as the primary elections for the mayoral election. Candidates ran as nonpartisans, and if no candidate received a majority of votes in a given ward the top two candidates in that ward faced off in a runoff election on April 5, the same day as the general mayoral election.

en.t: Latvia’s parliament begins presidential voting after Jānis Čakste’s death
en.s: On April 5, 1927, Latvia’s parliament began voting for a president following the death of Jānis Čakste. The election continued over several sittings, and Gustavs Zemgals was elected on April 8.

en.s: State elections were held in South Australia on 5 April 1930. All 46 seats in the South Australian House of Assembly were up for election. The incumbent Liberal Federation government led by Premier of South Australia Richard L. Butler was defeated by the opposition Australian Labor Party led by Leader of the Opposition Lionel Hill. Each district elected multiple members.

zh.s: 南澳大利亚州选举于1930年4月5日举行，州议会众议院全部46个席位都进行改选。由州长理查德·L·巴特勒领导的执政自由联盟政府败给了由反对党领袖莱昂内尔·希尔领导的澳大利亚工党。每个选区选出多名议员。

en.s: The Andorran Revolution, also known as the Revolution of 1933, was a democratic uprising led by the Young Andorrans (a trade union related to the CNT-FAI) that called for political reforms, universal suffrage for all Andorrans and acted in defense of the rights of local and foreign workers during the construction of FHASA's hydroelectric power station in Encamp. On April 5, 1933, the Young Andorrans seized the Andorran Parliament.

zh.s: 安道尔革命又称1933年革命，是一场由青年安道尔人组织领导的民主起义。该组织与全国劳工联盟—伊比利亚无政府主义联合会有关，要求进行政治改革、让所有安道尔人享有普选权，并在恩坎普水电站建设期间维护本地和外来工人的权利。1933年4月5日，青年安道尔人占领了安道尔议会。

en.s: The 1936 Tupelo–Gainesville tornado outbreak was an outbreak of at least 12 tornadoes that struck the Southeastern United States from April 5–6, 1936. Approximately 454 people were killed by these tornadoes—419 by two tornadoes alone. This outbreak is the second deadliest ever recorded in US history. Although the outbreak was centered on Tupelo, Mississippi, and Gainesville, Georgia, where the fourth and fifth deadliest tornadoes in U.S. history respectively occurred, other destructive tornadoes associated with the outbreak struck Columbia, Tennessee; Anderson, South Carolina; and Acworth, Georgia. This is the only continuous tornado outbreak in U.S. history to produce more than one tornado with triple digit death tolls.

zh.t: 1936年图珀洛—盖恩斯维尔龙卷风群
zh.s: 1936年4月5日至6日，美国东南部至少遭12场龙卷风袭击，约454人死亡，其中419人死于两场龙卷风。按原文记载，这是美国有记录以来死亡人数第二多的龙卷风过程。密西西比州图珀洛和佐治亚州盖恩斯维尔分别遭遇美国历史上第四和第五致命的龙卷风，田纳西州哥伦比亚、南卡罗来纳州安德森及佐治亚州阿克沃思也遭破坏性龙卷风袭击。原文称，这是美国唯一一次连续龙卷风过程中，有不止一场龙卷风分别造成三位数死亡的事件。

en.s: The Spanish Civil War (Spanish: guerra civil española) was fought in Spain from 1936 to 1939 between the Republicans and the Nationalist rebels. Republicans loyal to the left-leaning Popular Front government of the Second Spanish Republic included socialists, anarchists, communists, and separatists, supported by the Soviet Union. The opposing Nationalists were an alliance of Falangists, monarchists, conservatives, traditionalists, syndicalists and fascists, supported by Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy.

zh.t: 西班牙内战：国民军占领加泰罗尼亚城市莱里达两天后，独裁者弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥下令废除加泰罗尼亚自治区政府、共和国授予的自治权以及加泰罗尼亚语的官方地位
zh.s: 西班牙内战（西班牙语：guerra civil española）于1936年至1939年在西班牙发生，交战双方是共和派和国民军叛军。效忠左翼第二西班牙共和国人民阵线政府的共和派包括社会主义者、无政府主义者、共产主义者和分离主义者，并得到苏联支持。国民军则由长枪党人、君主主义者、保守派、传统主义者、工团主义者和法西斯主义者结成联盟，得到纳粹德国和法西斯意大利支持。

Green by a double-digit margin. Both major parties held primary elections to determine their nominees. The primaries were held on February 28, 1939. Kelly won renomination in the Democratic Party primary against Thomas J.

zh.s: 1939年4月5日，芝加哥举行市长选举。现任市长爱德华·J.凯利以两位数百分点优势击败德怀特·H.格林，赢得第二个完整任期，若计入此前任期则为第三任。两大党均于2月28日举行初选确定候选人。凯利在民主党初选中再次获提名。原文在介绍其初选对手的姓名“Thomas J.”时中断。

en.s: Between 9 March and 5 April 1942 during World War II, forces of the Empire of Japan occupied the islands of Buka and Bougainville in the South Pacific. At that time these islands were part of the Australian-administered Territory of New Guinea. A platoon of Australian commandos from the 1st Independent Company was located at Buka Airfield when the Japanese landed but did not contest the invasion. The Japanese invaded in order to construct naval and air bases to provide security for their major base at Rabaul, New Britain and to support strategic operations in the Solomon Islands.

zh.t: 日军入侵布卡岛与布干维尔岛
zh.s: 1942年3月9日至4月5日，第二次世界大战期间，日本军队占领南太平洋的布卡岛和布干维尔岛。当时两岛属于澳大利亚管理的新几内亚领地。日军登陆时，澳军第一独立连的一个突击队排驻在布卡机场，但未抵抗入侵。日军意图在岛上修建海空基地，保护新不列颠岛拉包尔的重要基地，并支援其在所罗门群岛的战略行动。

en.s: The Easter Sunday Raid (or Battle of Ceylon) was an air attack by carrier-based aircraft of the Imperial Japanese Navy against Colombo, Ceylon (now Sri Lanka), on Easter Sunday, 5 April 1942, during World War II. This attack was part of the Indian Ocean Raid, and was followed a few days later by a similar attack on Trincomalee. The targets were British warships, harbour installations, and air bases; the object was to disrupt the war effort of British Commonwealth nations and force the British Eastern Fleet to leave Asian waters.

zh.s: 1942年4月5日复活节星期日，第二次世界大战期间，日本海军舰载机袭击锡兰（今斯里兰卡）科伦坡，事件也称锡兰战役。这是日军印度洋突袭的一部分，数日后又对亭可马里发动类似空袭。攻击目标包括英国军舰、港口设施及空军基地，旨在破坏英联邦国家的战争行动，并迫使英国东方舰队撤离亚洲海域。

en.s: The Polesskoe offensive operation (Russian: Полесская наступательная операция, Polesskaya nastupatelnaya operatsiya), known on the German side as the Battle of Kovel (German: Schlacht um Kowel), was a major Soviet offensive operation, executed in the Polesie region between 15 March and 5 April 1944. Launched by the newly activated 2nd Belorussian Front, the offensive targeted the strategic rail hub of Kovel, located at the boundary line of the German Army Group Center and Army Group South.

zh.s: 1944年3月15日至4月5日，苏军在波列西耶地区发动大规模攻势，德方称其为科韦利战役。新组建的白俄罗斯第二方面军发起行动，目标是位于德军中央集团军群与南方集团军群分界处的战略铁路枢纽科韦利。

en.s: The Georgian Uprising on Texel (Dutch: Opstand der Georgiërs) (5 April 1945 – 20 May 1945) was an insurrection by the 882nd Infantry Battalion Königin Tamara (Queen Tamar or Tamara) of the Georgian Legion of the German Army (Wehrmacht Heer) stationed on the German occupied Dutch island of Texel (pronounced Tessel). The battalion was made up of 800 Georgians and 400 Germans, with mainly German officers.

zh.t: 特塞尔岛格鲁吉亚人起义
zh.s: 1945年4月5日至5月20日，驻守德占荷兰特塞尔岛的德军格鲁吉亚军团第882“塔玛尔女王”步兵营发动起义。该营由800名格鲁吉亚人和400名德国人组成，军官主要为德国人。特塞尔岛的荷兰语名称读作“Tessel”。

en.s: The 1946 Rabat Vickers Wellington crash was a military aviation accident that occurred in Malta on 5 April 1946 when a Vickers Wellington bomber crashed during a training exercise in a residential area in Rabat. All four crew members on board the aircraft and 16 civilians on the ground were killed. The crash also caused extensive property damage. The exact cause was never conclusively determined, but a magisterial inquiry suggested that leakage of hydraulic fluid leading to crew incapacitation could be a probable cause.

zh.t: 1946年拉巴特惠灵顿轰炸机空难
zh.s: 1946年4月5日，马耳他一架维克斯惠灵顿轰炸机在训练中坠入拉巴特住宅区，机上四名机组人员和地面16名平民全部死亡，并造成大范围财产损失。事故确切原因始终未获最终确认，但司法调查认为，液压油泄漏导致机组失去行动能力，可能是原因之一。

en.s: The Battle of Bali Strait (also referred to as the Banyuwangi-Bali Operation Strait) marked the first amphibious battle conducted by the Indonesian Navy in the Bali Strait. Fought on 5 April 1946, the engagement pitted the early Indonesian Navy against the much better equipped Dutch Royal Navy. The battle concluded with a significant victory for the Indonesian forces, cementing its place in the history of Indonesia's struggle for independence.

zh.s: 巴厘海峡战役又称外南梦-巴厘海峡行动，是印度尼西亚海军首次实施的两栖作战。战斗于1946年4月5日打响，印尼海军对阵装备精良得多的荷兰皇家海军。印尼军队取得重大胜利，这场战斗因此成为印尼独立斗争历史的一部分。

en.s: The 1946–47 Scottish League Cup final was played on 5 April 1947, at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the first official Scottish League Cup competition. The final was contested by Rangers and Aberdeen. Rangers won the match 4–0 thanks to goals by Jimmy Duncanson (2), Torrance Gillick and Billy Williamson.

zh.s: 1946—1947赛季苏格兰联赛杯决赛于1947年4月5日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，是首届正式苏格兰联赛杯的决赛。流浪者凭借吉米·邓肯森的两球，以及托伦斯·吉利克和比利·威廉森各一球，以4比0击败阿伯丁。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held on 5 April 1947 to elect the Governor of Saga Prefecture. Former governor Gen'ichi Okimori defeated six other candidates to become the prefecture's first democratically elected governor.

zh.s: 1947年4月5日举行佐贺县知事选举。前知事冲守源一击败另外六名候选人，当选该县首位经民主选举产生的知事。

en.s: The 1949 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on April 5, 1949, with a run-off election on May 31, 1949. Incumbent Fletcher Bowron was re-elected. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 1949年洛杉矶市长选举于4月5日举行，5月31日举行决选。现任市长弗莱彻·鲍伦连任。加利福尼亚州的市政选举（包括洛杉矶市长选举）在法律上不设党派，候选人的党派归属不会印在选票上。

en.s: The 1950 Sheffield Neepsend by-election was a parliamentary by-election held on 5 April 1950 for the British House of Commons constituency of Sheffield Neepsend in Neepsend, an industrial suburb of the city of Sheffield. The seat had become vacant when the constituency's Labour Member of Parliament (MP), Harry Morris, was elevated to the peerage as the first Baron Morris of Kenwood.

zh.t: 1950年谢菲尔德尼普森德选区补选
zh.s: 1950年谢菲尔德尼普森德选区补选于4月5日举行，选出英国下议院谢菲尔德尼普森德选区的议员。该席位原由工党议员哈里·莫里斯担任；他获封肯伍德男爵，离开下议院后，席位因此出缺。

en.s: The Ormskirk by-election of 5 April 1951 was held after the appointment of Conservative MP Ronald Cross as Governor of Tasmania.

en.s: The 1955 Chicago mayoral election saw Democrat Richard J. Daley win election to his first term as mayor by a ten-point margin over Republican Robert E. Merriam. en.s: Sir Winston Leonard Spencer Churchill (30 November 1874 – 24 January 1965) was a British statesman, military officer, and writer who was Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1940 to 1945, during the Second World War, and again from 1951 to 1955. For some 62 of the years between 1900 and 1964, he was a member of Parliament (MP) and represented a total of five constituencies over that time.

zh.t: 丘吉尔辞去英国首相职务
zh.s: 1955年4月5日，温斯顿·丘吉尔辞去英国首相职务，结束第二次首相任期。丘吉尔生于1874年、逝于1965年，是英国政治家、军官和作家，曾在二战期间的1940年至1945年、以及1951年至1955年两度担任首相。1900年至1964年间，他累计约62年任下议院议员，先后代表五个选区。

en.s: The Stockton-on-Tees by-election, 1962 was a parliamentary by-election held for the House of Commons constituency of Stockton-on-Tees in County Durham on 5 April 1962. It was the by-election at which Bill Rodgers, a future Cabinet minister and member of the "Gang of Four" of senior Labour politicians who defected to form the SDP, entered Parliament. Rodgers subsequently helped to lead the SDP into the merger that formed the Liberal Democrats, and later served as that party's leader in the House of Lords.

zh.t: 1962年蒂斯河畔斯托克顿选区补选
zh.s: 1962年4月5日，英国达勒姆郡蒂斯河畔斯托克顿下议院选区举行补选，比尔·罗杰斯由此进入议会。他后来担任内阁部长，并成为退出工党、组建社会民主党的四位资深政治家之一，即所谓“四人帮”。此后他又协助领导社会民主党合并成立自由民主党，并曾任该党上议院领袖。

zh.t: 1966年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1966年4月5日星期二，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。现任法官托马斯·E.费尔柴尔德无竞争连任，取得第二个任期。选前有人担心他会面临强劲挑战，因为他曾撰写1964年一宗麦考利案的多数意见。原文在案件名称“McCauley vs.”处中断。

en.s: The Buddhist Uprising of 1966 (Vietnamese: Nổi dậy Phật giáo 1966), or more widely known in Vietnam as the Crisis in Central Vietnam (Biến động Miền Trung), was a period of civil and military unrest in South Vietnam, mostly in the I Corps area in the north of the country in central Vietnam.
en.n: During the Buddhist Uprising, South Vietnamese Prime Minister Nguyễn Cao Kỳ personally attempts to lead the capture of the restive city of Đà Nẵng before backing down.

zh.s: 1966年佛教徒起义（越南语：Nổi dậy Phật giáo 1966），在越南也更常称为中部越南危机（Biến động Miền Trung），是南越一段政治和军事动荡时期，主要发生在该国北部的第一军区一带。
zh.n: 佛教徒起义期间，南越总理阮高祺曾亲自试图率军夺取局势动荡的岘港，后来又打消了这一念头。

en.s: The 1968–69 Scottish League Cup final was played on 5 April 1969 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 23rd Scottish League Cup competition. The final was contested by Hibernian and Celtic. Celtic won a one-sided match by 6–2, with Bobby Lennox scoring a hat-trick. Bertie Auld, Jim Craig and Willie Wallace scored Celtic's other goals, while Jimmy O'Rourke and Eric Stevenson scored for Hibs.

zh.s: 1968—1969赛季苏格兰联赛杯决赛于1969年4月5日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，是第23届赛事决赛。凯尔特人以6比2大胜希伯尼安，鲍比·伦诺克斯上演帽子戏法，伯蒂·奥尔德、吉姆·克雷格和威利·华莱士各入一球；希伯尼安由吉米·奥罗克和埃里克·史蒂文森进球。

en.t: Carrie, the first novel by American author Stephen King, is published for the first time with a print run of 30,000 copies
en.s: Stephen Edwin King (born September 21, 1947) is an American author. Dubbed the "King of Horror", he is widely known for his horror fiction and has also explored other genres, among them suspense, crime, science-fiction, fantasy, and mystery. He has written approximately 200 short stories, most of which have been published in collections.

zh.t: 美国作家斯蒂芬·金的首部长篇小说《魔女嘉莉》首次出版，首印30,000册
zh.s: 斯蒂芬·埃德温·金（生于1947年9月21日）是美国作家，被誉为“恐怖小说之王”，以恐怖小说闻名，也涉足悬疑、犯罪、科幻、奇幻和推理等类型。他写了约200篇短篇小说，其中大多数已收入选集出版。

en.s: The 1977 St. Louis mayoral election was held on April 5, 1977 to elect the mayor of St. Louis, Missouri. It saw the election of James F. Conway. Incumbent mayor John Poelker decided not to seek a second term. The election was preceded by party primaries on March 8.

zh.s: 1977年圣路易斯市长选举于4月5日举行，选出密苏里州圣路易斯市长。詹姆斯·F·康威当选。现任市长约翰·波尔克决定不竞选连任。此前，候选人于3月8日参加了党内初选。

en.s: The 1977 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on April 5, 1977. Incumbent Tom Bradley was re-elected over nine other candidates. He was mainly challenged by State Senator Alan Robbins and tax policy activist Howard Jarvis, with Robbins campaigning on his opposition to busing in the city. Bradley was widely expected to easily win re-election, and on election day, Bradley won by a landslide against the other candidates.

zh.s: 1977年洛杉矶市长选举于4月5日举行。现任市长汤姆·布拉德利击败另外九名候选人连任。主要对手是州参议员艾伦·罗宾斯和税收政策活动人士霍华德·贾维斯；罗宾斯竞选时反对在市内推行学生校车接送。布拉德利普遍被认为会轻松连任，最终也以压倒性优势获胜。

en.t: The US Supreme Court rules that congressional legislation that diminished the size of the Sioux people's reservation thereby destroyed the tribe's jurisdictional authority over the area in Rosebud Sioux Tribe v. Kneip
en.s: The Supreme Court of the United States (SCOTUS) is the highest court in the federal judiciary of the United States. It has ultimate appellate jurisdiction over all U.S. federal court cases, and over state court cases that turn on questions of U.S. constitutional or federal law. It also has original jurisdiction over a narrow range of cases, specifically "all Cases affecting Ambassadors, other public Ministers and Consuls, and those in which a State shall be Party".

zh.t: 美国最高法院裁定，在“玫瑰花蕾苏族部落诉克奈普案”中，国会立法缩小苏族保留地范围，因而取消了该部落对该地区的管辖权
zh.s: 美国最高法院是美国联邦司法体系的最高法院，对所有联邦案件以及涉及美国宪法或联邦法律问题的州法院案件拥有最终上诉管辖权。它还对有限类别的案件拥有初审管辖权，具体包括涉及大使、其他外交使节和领事的案件，以及州作为当事方的案件。

en.s: The 1980 Bukit Raya by-election was a by-election that was held on 5 April 1980 for the Kedah State Legislative Assembly seat of Bukit Raya. It was called following the death of its PAS assemblyman Ismail Kasim. Ismail won the seat on 1978 Malaysian state elections against Abdul Aziz Ali of Barisan Nasional with a majority of 1,101.

zh.s: 1980年武吉拉也选区补选于4月5日举行，改选吉打州议会武吉拉也选区席位。补选因泛马伊斯兰党议员依斯迈·卡欣去世而举行。依斯迈曾在1978年马来西亚州选举中击败国民阵线候选人阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹·阿里，当选该席议员，领先1,101票。

en.s: The Battle of Kakiri (5 April 1981) was a raid by Popular Resistance Army (PRA) rebels to capture weapons and ammunition at a military outpost in Kakiri during the early Ugandan Bush War. Kakiri was defended by a Uganda National Liberation Army (UNLA) contingent. The insurgents successfully overran the outpost and then tried to retreat with their loot.

zh.s: 1981年4月5日，乌干达丛林战争初期，人民抵抗军叛军突袭卡基里一处军事前哨，意图夺取武器弹药。该前哨由乌干达民族解放军一支部队防守。叛军成功攻陷据点，随后试图携战利品撤退。

en.s: 1981 Japanese Super Cup was the Japanese Super Cup competition. The match was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on April 5, 1981. Yanmar Diesel won the championship.

zh.s: 1981年日本超级杯是一场日本超级杯赛事。比赛于1981年4月5日在东京国立竞技场举行，洋马柴油机队夺得冠军。

en.s: 1982 Harmak incident refers to the accidental infiltration of Iranian territory during the Soviet–Afghan War, in which Soviet forces strayed from the target of a Mujahideen base in southern Afghanistan and accidentally destroyed an asphalt factory in Iran.

zh.s: 1982年哈马克事件是苏阿战争期间的一次意外越境事件。苏军偏离了阿富汗南部的一处圣战者基地目标，误入伊朗境内，意外摧毁了一家沥青厂。

en.s: The 1987 Hessian state election was held on 5 April 1987 to elect the 12th Landtag of Hesse. The outgoing government was a coalition of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and The Greens led by outgoing Minister-President Holger Börner, who retired at the election. The SPD campaign was led by finance minister Hans Krollmann, who ran to succeed him.

zh.s: 1987年4月5日，德国黑森州举行第12届州议会选举。即将卸任的政府由社会民主党与绿党联合组成，州长霍尔格·伯尔纳在此次选举时退休。社民党由财政部长汉斯·克罗尔曼领衔竞选，争取接任州长。

en.s: The 1987 Football League Cup final was a football match played on 5 April 1987 between Arsenal and Liverpool. The match, played in front of 96,000 spectators at Wembley Stadium, was won by Arsenal 2–1. Ian Rush opened the scoring for Liverpool with a side foot finish to the corner of the net, before Charlie Nicholas equalised, turning in a cross from the right in a crowded penalty area.

zh.s: 1987年足球联赛杯决赛于1987年4月5日举行，由阿森纳对阵利物浦。比赛在温布利球场进行，现场观众96,000人，阿森纳以2比1获胜。伊恩·拉什以脚内侧将球打入网角，为利物浦首开纪录；随后查理·尼古拉斯在禁区内拥挤的人群中接右路传中扳平比分。

en.s: The 1990 Copa del Rey final was the 88th final of the King's Cup. The final was played at Mestalla Stadium in Valencia on 5 April 1990, and was won by Barcelona, who beat Real Madrid 2–0.

zh.s: 第88届西班牙国王杯决赛于1990年4月5日在瓦伦西亚梅斯塔利亚球场举行。巴塞罗那以2比0击败皇家马德里夺冠。

en.s: General elections were held in Western Samoa on 5 April 1991, to determine the composition of the 11th Parliament. The elections were the first since the introduction of universal suffrage following a referendum held the previous year. However, candidates were still required to be Matai. The two main parties were the governing Human Rights Protection Party (HRPP), led by Prime Minister Tofilau Eti Alesana and the opposition Samoan National Development Party (SNDP), led by former Prime Minister Tupua Tamasese Efi.

zh.s: 1991年4月5日，西萨摩亚举行大选，选出第11届议会。这是前一年公投通过普选权后首次大选，但候选人仍须拥有“马泰”家族首领头衔。两大主要政党分别为总理托菲劳·埃蒂·阿莱萨纳领导的执政党人权保护党，以及前总理图普阿·塔马塞塞·埃菲领导的反对党萨摩亚民族发展党。

en.s: Atlantic Southeast Airlines Flight 2311 was a regularly scheduled commuter flight in Georgia in the southeastern United States, from Hartsfield–Jackson Atlanta International Airport to Glynco Jetport (since renamed Brunswick Golden Isles Airport) in Brunswick on April 5, 1991. The flight, operating a twin-turboprop Embraer EMB 120 Brasilia, crashed north of Brunswick while approaching the airport for landing. All 23 aboard were killed, including astronaut Sonny Carter and former U.S.

zh.t: 大西洋东南航空2311号班机空难
zh.s: 1991年4月5日，大西洋东南航空2311号定期通勤班机在美国佐治亚州布伦瑞克以北准备降落时坠毁，机上23人全部遇难，包括宇航员桑尼·卡特和前联邦参议员约翰·托尔。班机原定由亚特兰大哈茨菲尔德机场飞往布伦瑞克的格林科机场（今布伦瑞克金群岛机场），使用双涡轮螺旋桨发动机的巴西航空工业EMB 120客机。

en.s: The 1991 Iraqi uprisings were ethnic and religious uprisings against Saddam Hussein's Ba'athist regime that were mainly led by Shia rebels and Kurds. The uprisings lasted from March to April 1991 after a ceasefire following the end of the Gulf War. The mostly uncoordinated insurgency was fueled by the perception that Iraqi President Saddam Hussein had become vulnerable to regime change.

zh.s: 1991年伊拉克起义是反对萨达姆·侯赛因复兴党政权的民族和宗教起义，主要由什叶派反叛者和库尔德人领导。海湾战争结束并停火后，起义于1991年3月至4月间持续进行。当时人们认为伊拉克总统萨达姆·侯赛因已无力阻止政权更迭，这种看法推动了这场协调不力的叛乱。

en.s: WrestleMania VIII was the eighth annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It took place on April 5, 1992, at the Hoosier Dome in Indianapolis, Indiana. The card included two main events, both of which shared the official promotional poster. In the first, WWF World Heavyweight Champion Ric Flair defended his title against Randy Savage, and in the second, Hulk Hogan faced Sid Justice. As a consequence of the double main event, WrestleMania VIII carried two taglines rather than the usual one, those being "The Macho/Flair Affair!" and "Friendship Torn Apart!"

zh.s: 第八届摔角狂热是世界摔角联盟（WWF）制作的年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，于1992年4月5日在美国印第安纳州印第安纳波利斯胡希尔巨蛋体育场举行。赛事安排两场压轴级比赛，均登上官方海报：WWF世界重量级冠军瑞克·弗莱尔对阵兰迪·萨维奇，以及浩克·霍根对阵希德·贾斯蒂斯。因此本届采用两句宣传语，分别为“猛男与弗莱尔的恩怨！”及“友情破裂！”，而非惯常的一句。

en.s: The 1992 NSL Cup final was the final match of the 1991–92 NSL Cup, the 16th season of the National Soccer League Cup. It was played at Hindmarsh Stadium in Adelaide on 5 April 1992 between Adelaide City and Marconi Fairfield. Adelaide City won the match 2–1 for their third NSL Cup title.

zh.t: 1992年澳大利亚全国足球联赛杯决赛
zh.s: 1991—1992赛季澳大利亚全国足球联赛杯决赛，是第16届赛事的最后一场比赛，于1992年4月5日在阿德莱德欣德马什体育场举行。阿德莱德城以2比1击败马可尼费尔菲尔德，第三次夺得该项冠军。

en.s: The 1992 Baden-Württemberg state election was held on 5 April 1992 to elect the members of the 10th Landtag of Baden-Württemberg. The incumbent Christian Democratic Union (CDU) government under Minister-President Erwin Teufel lost its majority. The CDU suffered a 9.4% swing, mostly to the national conservative Republicans, who managed to enter the Landtag due to the asylum debate and achieved their best result in a state election, placing third with 10.9%.

zh.s: 1992年4月5日，德国巴登-符腾堡州举行第十届州议会选举。州长埃尔温·托伊费尔领导的基督教民主联盟政府失去多数。基民盟得票率下降9.4个百分点，选票主要流向民族保守派的共和党。共和党借政治庇护争论进入州议会，以10.9%的得票率位居第三，创下本党州级选举最佳成绩。

en.s: Lombardy elected its eleventh delegation to the Italian Senate on April 5, 1992. This election was a part of national Italian general election of 1992 even if, according to the Italian Constitution, every senatorial challenge in each Region is a single and independent race. The election was won by the centrist Christian Democracy, as it happened at national level.

zh.t: 1992年伦巴第大区意大利参议院选举
zh.s: 1992年4月5日，伦巴第大区选出第11届派驻意大利参议院的议员。这是1992年意大利全国大选的一部分，但依照宪法，各大区参议员选举分别独立进行。与全国结果一样，中间派天主教民主党赢得本区选举。

en.s: The 1992 Schleswig-Holstein state election was held on 5 April 1992 to elect the members of the Landtag of Schleswig-Holstein. The incumbent Social Democratic Party (SPD) government led by Minister-President Björn Engholm narrowly retained its majority by a margin of one seat. The major change of the election was the entry of the national conservative German People's Union to the Landtag.

zh.t: 1992年石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州议会选举
zh.s: 1992年4月5日，德国石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州举行州议会选举。州长比约恩·恩格霍尔姆领导的社会民主党政府，以仅一席优势保住多数。此次主要变化，是民族保守派的德国人民联盟进入州议会。

en.s: The 1992 Peruvian self-coup, sometimes known as the Fujimorazo, was performed in Peru in 1992 after President Alberto Fujimori dissolved the Congress as well as the judiciary and assumed full legislative and judicial powers. With the collaboration of the military, the Fujimori government arrested prominent opposition leaders and journalists, as well as seized government buildings. Following the coup, the Fujimori government subsequently began to implement objectives of the Green Plan.

zh.s: 1992年4月5日，秘鲁总统阿尔韦托·藤森在军方支持下宣布由自己全面掌控政府，解散国会并暂停司法系统运作。政府逮捕了知名反对派人士和记者，并控制政府机构。此后，藤森政府开始推行“绿色计划”的相关目标。

en.s: The 1994 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on April 5, 1994, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a ten-year term. Incumbent justice Janine P. Geske (who had been appointed the previous year to fill a vacancy on the seat) was re-elected over challenger William A. Pangman.

zh.t: 1994年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1994年4月5日，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。前一年获任命填补空缺的现任法官贾宁·P.格斯克，击败挑战者威廉·A.潘格曼，成功连任。

en.t: In Japan, the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge opens to traffic, becoming the longest bridge span in the world
en.s: The Akashi Kaikyo Bridge (Japanese: 明石海峡大橋, Hepburn: Akashi Kaikyō Ōhashi) is a suspension bridge that links the city of Kobe on the Japanese island of Honshu and Iwaya, Awaji on Awaji Island. It is part of the Kobe-Awaji-Naruto Expressway, and crosses the busy and turbulent Akashi Strait (Akashi Kaikyō in Japanese). It was completed in 1998, and at the time, was the longest central span of any suspension bridge in the world, at 1,991 metres (6,532 ft).

zh.s: 1998年4月5日，日本明石海峡大桥通车，横跨水流湍急、船只繁忙的明石海峡，连接本州神户与淡路岛岩屋，属于神户－淡路－鸣门高速公路。大桥于1998年完工，当时其1,991米主跨是世界最长的悬索桥中央跨度。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in on 5 April 2004 for both houses of the People's Consultative Assembly of Indonesia. This included all 550 seats in the People's Representative Council and 128 seats of the newly formed Regional Representative Council. Final results of the popular vote tally showed that Golkar, the former ruling party of the New Order era, received the most votes.

zh.s: 印度尼西亚于2004年4月5日举行立法选举，改选人民协商会议两院成员，包括人民代表会议全部550个席位，以及新成立的地方代表会议128个席位。最终普选票统计显示，旧秩序时期的执政党专业集团党得票最多。

en.s: The 2005 Saint Louis mayoral election was held on April 5, 2005 to elect the mayor of St. Louis, Missouri. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Francis Slay to a second term. The election was preceded by party primaries on March 8.

zh.s: 2005年圣路易斯市长选举于4月5日举行，选出密苏里州圣路易斯市长。现任市长弗朗西斯·斯雷连任，开始第二个任期。此前，候选人于3月8日参加党内初选。

en.t: The cruise ship MS Sea Diamond strikes a volcanic reef near Nea Kameni and sinks the next day. Two passengers were never recovered and are presumed dead
en.s: MS Sea Diamond was a cruise ship operated by Louis Hellenic Cruise Lines. She was built in 1984 by Valmet, Finland for Birka Line as Birka Princess. The ship ran aground near the Greek island of Santorini 5 April 2007, and sank the next day leaving two passengers missing and presumed dead.

zh.t: “海钻石”号邮轮触礁，次日沉没
zh.s: “海钻石”号是路易希腊邮轮公司运营的一艘邮轮。该船由芬兰瓦尔梅特造船厂于1984年建造，最初名为“比尔卡公主”号，供比尔卡航运公司使用。2007年4月5日，该船在希腊圣托里尼岛附近触礁，次日沉没，两名乘客失踪并被推定已死亡。

en.s: The year 2007 was the 15th year in the history of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), a mixed martial arts promotion based in the United States. In 2007 the UFC held 19 events beginning with, UFC Fight Night: Evans vs. Salmon.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：史蒂文森对吉拉德
zh.s: 2007年4月5日，总部位于美国的综合格斗推广机构UFC在拉斯维加斯举办“史蒂文森对吉拉德”格斗之夜赛事。2007年是UFC办赛的第十五年，当年共举办19场活动，始于“埃文斯对萨蒙”格斗之夜。

en.t: 2008 U.S. Virgin Islands Republican presidential caucuses
en.s: The 2008 U.S. Virgin Islands Republican territorial meeting, also known as the Republican caucuses, took place on the U.S. Virgin Islands of St. Croix and St. Thomas on April 5, 2008. Virgin Islands Republicans could select six pledged delegates for the 2008 Republican National Convention; three party leaders also attended the convention as unpledged delegates.

zh.t: 2008年美属维尔京群岛共和党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2008年4月5日，美属维尔京群岛共和党在圣克罗伊岛和圣托马斯岛举行领地会议，也称党团会议。当地共和党人可选出六名承诺支持候选人的全国代表大会代表，另有三名党内领导人以不受候选人承诺约束的代表身份参会。

en.s: The 2008 Netball Superleague Grand Final featured Galleria Mavericks and Loughborough Lightning. Having played in both the 2006 and 2007 grand finals, this was Mavericks' third successive grand final appearance. It proved third time lucky for Mavericks who defeated Lightning 43–39. Lightning were leading 21–14 at half time thanks to an outstanding shooting performance from 19-year-old Joanne Harten.

zh.t: 2008年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2008年4月5日，Galleria Mavericks在总决赛中以43比39击败Loughborough Lightning。此前已连续两年打入总决赛的Mavericks，第三次终于夺冠。上半场结束时，Lightning以21比14领先。

en.s: WEC 40: Torres vs. Mizugaki was a mixed martial arts event held by World Extreme Cagefighting on April 5, 2009 at the UIC Pavilion in Chicago, Illinois. The event aired live on the Versus Network.

zh.s: WEC 40：托雷斯对水垣，是世界极限笼斗组织于2009年4月5日，在美国伊利诺伊州芝加哥伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校体育馆举办的综合格斗赛事，由Versus电视网直播。

en.s: WrestleMania 25, also promoted as The 25th Anniversary of WrestleMania, was a 2009 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It was the 25th annual WrestleMania and took place on April 5, 2009, at Reliant Stadium in Houston, Texas, held for wrestlers from the promotion's Raw, SmackDown, and ECW brand divisions. This was the second WrestleMania held in Houston, after WrestleMania X-Seven in 2001 at the Reliant Astrodome.

zh.s: 第二十五届摔角狂热以“摔角狂热25周年”为宣传主题，是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）制作的年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2009年4月5日在美国得克萨斯州休斯敦信实体育场举行，参赛者来自Raw、SmackDown和ECW三个品牌。这是休斯敦继2001年信实太空巨蛋的第十七届之后，第二次承办摔角狂热。

en.s: The presidential primaries of the Concertación de Partidos por la Democracia of 2009 were the method of election of the presidential candidate of such a Chilean coalition for the 2009 presidential election. Eduardo Frei Ruiz-Tagle, former President of Chile (1994–2000), a member of the Christian Democrat Party (PDC) and candidate for his party, the Socialist Party of Chile (PS) and the Party for Democracy (PPD), and José Antonio Gómez, a militant and candidate of the Radical Social Democratic Party. After having established different regional dates, on the condition that the candidate was immediately proclaimed winner of the contestant by twenty percentage points or more, only the first date, on April 5, 2009, was made in the Region of O'Higgins and in the Maule Region.

zh.t: 2009年智利民主协商联盟总统初选
zh.s: 2009年，智利民主协商联盟通过初选确定参加当年总统选举的候选人。两名竞争者分别为基督教民主党成员、前总统（1994—2000年）爱德华多·弗雷·鲁伊斯-塔格莱，以及激进社会民主党的何塞·安东尼奥·戈麦斯。弗雷获得本党、智利社会党和争取民主党共同支持。初选原定分地区在不同日期进行，但规则规定，若一名候选人领先对手至少20个百分点，即可直接宣布胜出。因此最终只在首个日期2009年4月5日，于奥希金斯和马乌莱两个大区举行投票。

en.s: The 2009 Football League Trophy Final was the 26th final of the domestic football cup competition for teams from Football Leagues One and Two, the Football League Trophy. The final was played at Wembley Stadium in London on 5 April 2009, the second time that the final had been staged at the stadium since it was rebuilt. The match was contested between Luton Town and Scunthorpe United.

zh.s: 2009年英格兰联赛锦标赛决赛，是这项供英甲、英乙球队参加的国内足球杯赛的第26届决赛，于4月5日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由卢顿镇对阵斯肯索普联。这是温布利重建后第二次承办该项决赛。

en.s: Dream.8: Welter Weight Grand Prix 2009 First Round was a mixed martial arts event promoted by Fighting and Entertainment Group's mixed martial arts promotion Dream on April 5, 2009. Unlike Dream's past tournaments, the Welter Weight Grand Prix is only scheduled to have eight participants. DREAM's welterweight division has a 76 kilograms (168 lb) weight limit.

zh.s: Dream 8：2009年次中量级大奖赛首轮是综合格斗赛事，由格斗与娱乐集团旗下的Dream赛事主办，于2009年4月5日举行。与Dream以往的锦标赛不同，本届次中量级大奖赛只安排八名选手参赛。Dream次中量级的体重上限为76公斤（168磅）。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Macedonia in 2009. The first round was held on 22 March, alongside local elections. As no candidate received more than 50% of the vote, a run-off round was held on 5 April 2009, which was won by Gjorge Ivanov of the center-right VMRO-DPMNE party. Incumbent President Branko Crvenkovski did not stand for re-election.

zh.s: 北马其顿于2009年举行总统选举。首轮投票于3月22日举行，并与地方选举同日进行。由于没有候选人得票超过50%，第二轮投票于2009年4月5日举行，中右翼马其顿内部革命组织—马其顿民族统一民主党候选人乔尔杰·伊万诺夫获胜。现任总统布兰科·茨尔文科夫斯基没有竞选连任。

en.s: The Battle of Aanandapuram was a land battle fought between the Sri Lankan Military, 58 Division, 53 Division and Task Force 8 and the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) for the control of the last stronghold held by the LTTE. This battle was a part of the Northern Theatre of Eelam War IV during the Sri Lankan civil war.

zh.s: 阿南达普拉姆战役是一场陆战，交战双方为斯里兰卡军队的第58师、第53师和第8特遣部队，以及泰米尔伊拉姆猛虎解放组织。双方争夺猛虎组织控制的最后据点。此战是斯里兰卡内战第四次埃拉姆战争北方战区作战的一部分。

en.s: The Upper Big Branch Mine disaster occurred on April 5, 2010 roughly 1,000 feet (300 m) underground in Raleigh County, West Virginia at Massey Energy's Upper Big Branch coal mine located in Montcoal. Twenty-nine out of thirty-one miners at the site were killed. The coal dust explosion occurred at 3:27 pm. The accident was the worst in the United States since 1970, when 38 miners were killed at Finley Coal Company's No. 15 and 16 mines in Hyden, Kentucky. A state funded independent investigation would later find Massey Energy directly responsible for the blast.

zh.s: 2010年4月5日下午3时27分，美国西弗吉尼亚州罗利县蒙特科尔的梅西能源公司上大支流煤矿，在地下约1000英尺（300米）处发生煤尘爆炸。现场31名矿工中有29人遇难。这是美国自1970年肯塔基州海登芬利煤炭公司15号和16号矿38人遇难以来，最严重的矿难。州政府资助的独立调查后来认定，梅西能源对爆炸负有直接责任。

en.s: On April 5, 2010, two bombings in Pakistan killed up to 50 people and injured 100 more. In the first attack the U.S. Consulate in Peshawar was attacked by militants. The coordinated attack involved a vehicle suicide bomb and attackers who tried to enter the U.S. Consulate in Peshawar by using grenades and weapons fire.

zh.t: 2010年巴基斯坦西北边境省袭击
zh.s: 2010年4月5日，巴基斯坦两起爆炸袭击造成多达50人死亡、另100人受伤。第一起针对白沙瓦美国领事馆，武装人员协同发动袭击，使用自杀式汽车炸弹，并试图以手榴弹和枪火掩护闯入领事馆。

en.s: STS-131 (ISS assembly flight 19A) was a NASA Space Shuttle mission to the International Space Station (ISS). Space Shuttle Discovery launched on April 5, 2010, at 6:21 am from LC-39A, and landed at 9:08 am on April 20, 2010, on runway 33 at the Kennedy Space Center's Shuttle Landing Facility. The mission marked the longest flight for Space Shuttle Discovery and its 38th and penultimate flight.

zh.s: STS-131（国际空间站组装任务19A）是美国国家航空航天局的一次航天飞机任务，目标为国际空间站。发现号航天飞机于2010年4月5日早上6时21分从39A发射台升空，并于4月20日上午9时08分在肯尼迪航天中心航天飞机着陆设施的33号跑道着陆。此次任务是发现号最长的一次飞行，也是它第38次、倒数第二次飞行。

en.s: The 2011 Wichita mayoral election took place on April 5, 2011, to elect the Mayor of Wichita, Kansas. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Carl Brewer.

zh.s: 2011年4月5日，美国堪萨斯州威奇托举行市长选举，与其他多项地方选举同期进行。选举正式采取无党派形式，现任市长卡尔·布鲁尔连任。

en.s: The 2011 Brown County, Wisconsin Executive election took place on April 5, 2011. Incumbent County Executive Tom Hinz declined to run for re-election to a second term. Five candidates ran to succeed him, the most candidates to run for the position since the 1995 special election. Three members of the County Board of Supervisors—Tim Carpenter, Patrick Moynihan, and Andy Nicholson—and businessmen Troy Streckenbach and Paul Linzmeyer ran in the election.

zh.t: 2011年威斯康星州布朗县县长选举
zh.s: 2011年4月5日，美国威斯康星州布朗县举行县长选举。现任县长汤姆·欣茨不再寻求第二个任期。共有五人竞逐继任者职位，是1995年特别选举以来参选人数最多的一次。候选人为县议员蒂姆·卡彭特、帕特里克·莫伊尼汉和安迪·尼科尔森，以及商人特洛伊·斯特雷肯巴赫和保罗·林茨迈耶。

en.s: The 2011 Outagamie County Executive election took place on April 5, 2011, to elect the County Executive of Outagamie County, Wisconsin. Incumbent County Executive Toby Paltzer declined to seek re-election to a fourth term. Six candidates ran to succeed Paltzer: former State Representative Tom Nelson; former State Treasurer Jack Voight; County Supervisors Charlie Kramer, Anne Strauch, and Mike Thomas; and Grand Chute Town Chairman Mike Marsden.

zh.s: 2011年4月5日，美国威斯康星州奥塔加米县举行县长选举。现任县长托比·帕尔策不再寻求第四个任期。六人竞逐该职：前州众议员汤姆·纳尔逊、前州财政部长杰克·沃伊特、县议员查理·克雷默、安妮·施特劳赫和迈克·托马斯，以及大舒特镇主席迈克·马斯登。

en.s: The 2011 Milwaukee County Executive special election took place on April 5, 2011, following a primary election on February 15, 2011. County Executive Scott Walker was elected Governor of Wisconsin in 2010, triggering a special election. Walker resigned as County Executive on December 27, 2010, which temporarily elevated Lee Holloway, the Chairman of the County Board of Supervisors, as acting County Executive.

zh.t: 2011年密尔沃基县县长特别选举
zh.s: 2011年4月5日，美国密尔沃基县举行县长特别选举，此前已于2月15日举行初选。原县长斯科特·沃克在2010年当选威斯康星州州长，引发此次特别选举。沃克于2010年12月27日辞去县长职务，县议会主席李·霍洛韦临时升任代县长。

en.s: The 2011 Wisconsin Spring Election was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin on April 5, 2011. The featured race at the top of the ticket was a seat on the Wisconsin Supreme Court, which was seen as an early referendum on the policies of the newly inaugurated governor, Scott Walker. Several other nonpartisan local and judicial offices were also decided on the April ballot, including mayoral elections in some of Wisconsin's larger cities—Green Bay, Madison, and Racine.

zh.s: 2011年4月5日，美国威斯康星州举行春季选举。最受关注的是最高法院的一个席位，这场竞争被视为对新任州长斯科特·沃克政策的一次早期公投。当天也决定多项无党派地方公职和法官职位，包括格林贝、麦迪逊及拉辛等州内较大城市的市长选举。

en.s: The 2011 Dane County Executive special election took place on April 5, 2011, following a primary election on February 15, 2011. Incumbent County Executive Kathleen Falk, who was first elected in 1997, announced that she would retire from office. In the primary election, State Representative Joe Parisi placed first, winning 26 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2011年4月5日，美国戴恩县举行县长特别选举，此前已于2月15日举行初选。自1997年起任县长的凯瑟琳·福尔克宣布退休。初选中，州众议员乔·帕里西以26%的得票率位居第一。

en.s: The 2011 Colorado Springs mayoral election took place on May 17 and April 5, 2011, to elect the mayor of Colorado Springs, Colorado. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections. The election was officially nonpartisan. This was the first mayor to elect a mayor of Colorado Springs to function under the strong mayor style of governance.

zh.t: 2011年科罗拉多斯普林斯市长选举首轮投票
zh.s: 2011年4月5日，美国科罗拉多斯普林斯举行市长选举首轮投票；未有人直接胜出，5月17日又举行第二轮投票。选举与当地其他选举同时进行，正式制度上不分党派，也是该市首次按强化市长权力的新治理模式选举市长。

en.s: The Battle of Taftanaz started on February 11, 2012, in Idlib Governorate, between anti-government fighters and Syrian Arab Army troops participating in a nationwide crackdown on dissent against Bashar al-Assad's government. Heavy fighting took place on the outskirts of the town of Taftanaz, killing 20 people. On the day of the battle Kofi Annan announced a cease-fire for the Syrian conflict.

zh.s: 塔夫塔纳兹战役于2012年2月11日在叙利亚伊德利卜省打响，交战双方是反政府武装和参与全国性镇压反巴沙尔·阿萨德政府抗议活动的叙利亚阿拉伯军队。塔夫塔纳兹镇郊发生激战，造成20人死亡。战斗当天，科菲·安南宣布叙利亚冲突各方达成停火。

zh.s: 第七届荣耀超级大赛是荣耀擂台（ROH）制作的职业摔角网络按次付费赛事，于2013年4月5日在美国纽约市哈默斯坦舞厅举行。

en.s: Operation Rah-e-Shahadat (English: Path of Martyrdom; Urdu:راه شهادث), was a codename of a joint military operation that was commenced on 5 April 2013 by the Pakistan Army, with assistance provided by the PAF and Navy for air support. In close coordination with Local Peace Committee (Aman Lashkar), the army troops and special operations forces, aided by Frontier Corps, to flush out TTP and LeI militants from the Tirah Valley of the Khyber Agency.

zh.s: “烈士之路行动”（乌尔都语：راه شهادث）是巴基斯坦陆军于2013年4月5日启动的一次联合军事行动，空中支援由巴基斯坦空军和海军提供。陆军与地方和平委员会（Aman Lashkar）密切配合，在边境军团协助下出动特种作战部队，清剿开伯尔特区提拉山谷的巴基斯坦塔利班运动和拉什卡尔-伊-伊斯兰武装人员。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Afghanistan on 5 April 2014, with a second round held on 14 June. Incumbent President Hamid Karzai was not eligible to run due to term limits. The registration period for presidential nominations was open from 16 September 2013 until 6 October 2013. A total of 27 candidates were confirmed to be running for office. However, on 22 October Afghanistan’s Independent Election Commission disqualified 16 of the candidates, leaving only 11 in the race. By April 2014 three candidates gave up the race and decided to support some of the eight remaining candidates.

zh.s: 阿富汗于2014年4月5日举行总统选举，第二轮于6月14日举行。现任总统哈米德·卡尔扎伊受任期限制不能参选。候选人登记期从2013年9月16日至10月6日，共27人获确认参选。但独立选举委员会于10月22日取消16人资格，只剩11人。到2014年4月，另有三人退出，转而支持剩下八名候选人中的部分人选。

en.t: 2014 Australian Senate special election in Western Australia
en.s: On 5 April 2014, an Australian Senate special election in Western Australia was held. The special election was held six months after the 2013 Australian federal election. The result of that 2013 election for the Australian Senate in Western Australia was voided on 20 February 2014 by the High Court of Australia, sitting as the Court of Disputed Returns, because 1,375 ballot papers were lost during an official recount in November 2013.

zh.t: 2014年西澳大利亚州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 西澳大利亚州于2014年4月5日举行联邦参议员特别选举，距2013年联邦选举仅六个月。澳大利亚高等法院以争议选举审理庭的身份于2014年2月20日裁定，2013年联邦选举中西澳大利亚州参议员选举结果无效，原因是2013年11月官方重新计票时遗失了1,375张选票。

en.s: WWE Hall of Fame (2014) was the event which featured the introduction of the 15th class to the WWE Hall of Fame. The event was produced by WWE on April 5, 2014, from the Smoothie King Center in New Orleans, Louisiana. The event took place the same weekend as WrestleMania XXX. The event aired live on the WWE Network, and was hosted by Jerry Lawler.

zh.s: 2014年WWE名人堂典礼为第15届WWE名人堂成员举行入选仪式。典礼由WWE于2014年4月5日在美国路易斯安那州新奥尔良的冰沙国王中心举办，与第三十届摔角狂热大赛在同一周末举行。典礼通过WWE Network现场直播，由杰瑞·劳勒主持。

en.s: The Rey del Ring (2015) show (Spanish for "King of the Ring") was an annual professional wrestling major event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), and took place on April 5, 2015 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. The main event was the Eponymous IWRG Rey del Ring tournament, the twelfth annual version of the tournament, which is IWRG's version of WWE's Royal Rumble event.

zh.s: 2015年“擂台之王”是墨西哥国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）制作的年度大型职业摔角赛事，于4月5日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。压轴赛为同名“擂台之王”锦标赛，这是第12届年度赛事，形式类似WWE的皇家大战。

en.s: The 2015 Scottish Challenge Cup final, also known as the Petrofac Training Cup final for sponsorship reasons, was a football match that took place at McDiarmid Park on 5 April 2015, between Livingston and Alloa Athletic. The match was televised by BBC ALBA. It was the 24th final of the Scottish Challenge Cup since it was first organised in 1990 to celebrate the centenary of the now defunct Scottish Football League, it is the second Challenge Cup Final since the SPFL was formed.

zh.s: 2015年苏格兰挑战杯决赛因赞助冠名也称Petrofac Training杯决赛，于2015年4月5日在麦克迪阿米德公园举行，由利文斯顿对阵阿洛亚竞技。比赛由BBC Alba转播。这是苏格兰挑战杯的第24届决赛。该赛事于1990年创办，以纪念已停办的苏格兰足球联赛成立一百周年；这是苏格兰职业足球联赛（SPFL）成立后的第二届挑战杯决赛。

en.s: The 2015 Idlib offensive refers to a series of rebel operations in the Idlib Governorate, during the Syrian Civil War. The offensive started with a rebel assault on the capital of the province, Idlib. According to The Economist, the capture of Idlib came about largely because Gulf Arab states "gave more backing to their proxies despite American objections."

zh.s: 2015年4月5日，叙利亚内战期间伊德利卜省的反对派攻势结束。战事始于3月24日，反对派首先进攻省会伊德利卜并将其占领。《经济学人》认为，海湾阿拉伯国家不顾美国反对，加强对其支持的叙利亚势力的援助，是该城陷落的重要原因。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的攻势结束日期。

en.s: The 2015 Tajik Football Super Cup was the 6th Tajik Supercup match, a football match which was contested between the 2014 Tajik League and Cup champions, Istiklol, and the Tajik League Runners-up, Khayr Vahdat.

zh.s: 2015年塔吉克斯坦足球超级杯是第六届塔吉克斯坦超级杯，由2014年塔吉克斯坦联赛和杯赛冠军伊斯蒂克洛尔对阵联赛亚军海尔·瓦赫达特。

en.s: The 2016 Milwaukee County Executive election took place on April 5, 2016, following a primary election on February 16, 2016. Incumbent County Executive Chris Abele ran for re-election to a second full term. He was challenged by State Senator Chris Larson. Larson narrowly placed first in the primary election, receiving 45 percent of the vote to Abele's 44 percent.

zh.s: 2016年4月5日，美国密尔沃基县举行县长选举，此前已于2月16日举行初选。现任县长克里斯·阿贝勒寻求第二个完整任期，州参议员克里斯·拉尔森向他挑战。拉尔森在初选中以45%的得票率微弱领先，阿贝勒获得44%。

en.s: The 2016 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on April 5, 2016, to elect a justice of the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a ten-year term. Incumbent justice Rebecca Bradley defeated Wisconsin Court of Appeals judge JoAnne Kloppenburg. As more than two candidates filed to run, a nonpartisan primary was held on February 17, 2016. In the primary, Milwaukee County circuit judge Joe Donald was eliminated.

zh.t: 2016年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 2016年4月5日，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。现任法官丽贝卡·布拉德利击败州上诉法院法官乔安妮·克洛彭堡。由于报名者超过两人，2月17日曾举行无党派初选，密尔沃基县巡回法院法官乔·唐纳德在其中被淘汰。

en.s: Columbia, Missouri held an election for mayor on April 5, 2016.

zh.t: 2016年密苏里州哥伦比亚市长选举
zh.s: 密苏里州哥伦比亚市于2016年4月5日举行市长选举。

en.s: The 2016 Milwaukee mayoral election was held on Tuesday, April 5, 2016, to elect the mayor for Milwaukee. Incumbent mayor Tom Barrett was elected to a fourth term, defeating Bob Donovan. Municipal elections in Wisconsin are non-partisan. The non-partisan primary was held on Tuesday, February 16, 2016, to narrow the field of candidates to two.

zh.s: 2016年密尔沃基市长选举于4月5日星期二举行。现任市长汤姆·巴雷特击败鲍勃·多诺万，赢得第四个任期。威斯康星州的市政选举不设党派。非党派初选于2016年2月16日星期二举行，从候选人中选出两人进入大选。

en.s: The 2016 Wisconsin Democratic presidential primary was held on April 5 in the U.S. state of Wisconsin as one of the Democratic Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. Vermont senator Bernie Sanders won the contest with 56.59%, distancing nationwide frontrunner Hillary Clinton by about 14 percentage points. The Wisconsin Republican primary, held on the same day in conjunction with the Democratic primary, yielded a win for Ted Cruz, who distanced nationwide frontrunner Donald Trump by 13%.

zh.t: 2016年威斯康星州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年威斯康星州民主党总统初选于4月5日举行，是2016年总统选举前民主党初选的一部分。佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯以56.59%的得票率获胜，领先全国领先候选人希拉里·克林顿约14个百分点。同日举行的共和党初选中，特德·克鲁兹获胜，领先全国领先候选人唐纳德·特朗普13个百分点。

en.s: The 2016 Wisconsin Republican presidential primary was held on April 5 in the U.S. state of Wisconsin as one of the Republican Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. Texas senator Ted Cruz won the contest with 48%, ahead of nationwide frontrunner Donald Trump by 13 percentage points. Taking advantage of the state's two-level "winner takes all" provision, Cruz took 36 out of the 42 available delegates.

zh.t: 2016年威斯康星州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年威斯康星州共和党总统初选于4月5日举行，是2016年总统选举前共和党初选的一部分。得克萨斯州参议员特德·克鲁兹以48%的得票率获胜，领先全国领先候选人唐纳德·特朗普13个百分点。得益于该州分层的“胜者全得”规则，克鲁兹拿下42个党代表名额中的36个。

en.s: On April 5, 2016, Wisconsin held its spring election. The ballot included a contested Wisconsin Supreme Court race and other judicial and local elections, including county executive and mayoral races in Milwaukee.
en.n: This records the spring election, separate from the November general election.

zh.s: 2016年4月5日，威斯康星州举行春季选举。选票包括一场有竞争的州最高法院法官选举，以及其他司法职位和地方公职选举，其中有密尔沃基县行政长官和市长选举。
zh.n: 此条记录春季选举，与11月的大选分开。

en.s: The 2016 Nagorno-Karabakh conflict, also known as the Four-Day War, April War, or April clashes, began along the former Nagorno-Karabakh line of contact on 1 April 2016 with the Artsakh Defence Army, backed by the Armenian Armed Forces, on one side and the Azerbaijani Armed Forces on the other. The clashes occurred in a region that is disputed between the self-proclaimed Republic of Artsakh and the Republic of Azerbaijan.

zh.s: 2016年纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫冲突又称四日战争、四月战争或四月冲突，于2016年4月1日在原纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫接触线沿线爆发。交战双方为得到亚美尼亚武装部队支持的阿尔察赫国防军，以及阿塞拜疆武装部队。该地区的主权归属存在争议，自称阿尔察赫共和国的政权与阿塞拜疆共和国均声称拥有该地区。

zh.t: 美国移民执法机构突查田纳西州屠宰场
zh.s: 2018年4月5日，美国移民与海关执法局等机构突查田纳西州格兰杰县乡间的东南肉类加工厂，拘留多名无证劳工。这座牛只屠宰和肉类包装设施位于比恩站镇以西约14公里；事件也称“比恩站移民执法局突查”或“格兰杰县移民执法局突查”。

en.s: Battle Riot II was a professional wrestling event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW). It took place on April 5, 2019 at the Melrose Ballroom in New York, New York. The event aired live as a two-hour special episode of Fusion on beIN Sports. It was the second event under the Battle Riot chronology. Twelve matches were contested at the event with four matches airing live at Battle Riot.

zh.s: 第二届“战斗暴乱”是职业摔角大联盟（MLW）制作的职业摔角赛事，于2019年4月5日在美国纽约市梅尔罗斯舞厅举行。赛事作为《Fusion》两小时特别节目，在beIN Sports直播。当天共进行12场比赛，其中四场通过“战斗暴乱”直播。

en.s: The Battle of Palma or the Battle for Palma was fought during late March and early April 2021 over control of the city of Palma in Mozambique, between the Mozambique Defence Armed Forces, other Mozambican security forces and private military contractors on one side, and Islamist rebels reportedly associated with the Islamic State (IS) on another side. The Islamists invaded the city, killing dozens of people before Mozambique regained control days later.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 帕尔马战役又称争夺帕尔马之战，于2021年3月下旬至4月上旬在莫桑比克帕尔马市及周边地区进行，交战双方争夺该市的控制权。一方是莫桑比克国防军、其他安全部队及私人军事承包商，另一方是据报与“伊斯兰国”有关联的伊斯兰武装分子。武装分子攻入该市，杀害数十人；几天后，莫桑比克方面重新控制了该市。

en.s: The Owerri prison break took place in the early hours of 5 April 2021, when a mass prison break occurred in Owerri, Imo State, Nigeria. A large armed group arrived in pickup trucks and on buses carrying rocket-propelled grenades, machine guns and rifles. The group entered the prison's yard by using explosives to break through the administrative block. The group released over 1,844 inmates from the jail.

zh.s: 2021年4月5日凌晨，尼日利亚伊莫州奥韦里发生大规模越狱。一支人数众多的武装团体乘坐皮卡车和巴士抵达，携带火箭推进榴弹、机枪和步枪。武装人员用爆炸物炸开行政楼，进入监狱院区，释放了1,844名以上囚犯。
