en.s: The 2022 Kenosha County Executive election took place on April 5, 2022 to elect the County Executive of Kenosha County, Wisconsin, US. Incumbent County Executive James Kreuser declined to seek re-election to a fifth term. In the first contested election since 2002, three candidates ran to succeed Kreuser: County Circuit Court Clerk Rebecca Matoska-Mentink, State Representative Samantha Kerkman, and County Board Supervisor Jerry Gulley.

zh.s: 2022年4月5日，美国威斯康星州基诺沙县举行县长选举。现任县长詹姆斯·克鲁泽不再寻求第五个任期。这是2002年以来该职位首次出现竞争，共有三名候选人：县巡回法院书记官丽贝卡·马托斯卡-门廷克、州众议员萨曼莎·柯克曼，以及县议员杰里·格利。

en.s: Columbia, Missouri held an election on April 5, 2022, concurrently with elections for the city council members for wards 3 and 4.

zh.t: 2022年密苏里州哥伦比亚市长选举
zh.s: 密苏里州哥伦比亚市于2022年4月5日举行市长选举；当天还举行了第3选区和第4选区市议员选举。

en.s: The 2022 Milwaukee mayoral special election was held on April 5, 2022, concurrent with Wisconsin's spring general election, to elect a new mayor of Milwaukee, Wisconsin, following the resignation of mayor Tom Barrett in December 2021. Acting mayor Cavalier Johnson, who had been president of the common council when Barrett resigned, won the election, receiving 71% of the vote and defeating alderman Bob Donovan.

zh.s: 2022年密尔沃基市长特别选举于4月5日举行，与威斯康星州春季大选同日，选出新任密尔沃基市长。此前，汤姆·巴雷特于2021年12月辞职。时任市议会主席卡瓦利尔·约翰逊在巴雷特辞职后代理市长，并在此次选举中以71%的选票获胜，击败市议员鲍勃·多诺万。

en.s: On April 5, 2022, Wisconsin held its spring election. Three Wisconsin Court of Appeals seats and various nonpartisan local and judicial offices were on the ballot, including a special election for mayor of Milwaukee.
en.n: This records the spring election, separate from the November general election.

zh.s: 2022年4月5日，威斯康星州举行春季选举。选票涉及州上诉法院的3个席位，以及多项不分党派的地方公职和司法职位，其中包括密尔沃基市长特别选举。
zh.n: 此条记录春季选举，与11月的大选分开。

en.s: The battle of the Wagadou Forest occurred on April 5, 2024, when clashes broke out between the Strategic Framework for the Defense of the People of Azawad (CSP-DPA) against Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) in the Wagadou forest, on the border between Mali and Mauritania. The clashes ended in a non-aggression pact between the two groups, allowing them to coordinate future attacks against the Malian Army and Wagner Group.

zh.s: 2024年4月5日，在马里与毛里塔尼亚边境的瓦加杜森林，阿扎瓦德人民防卫战略框架与支持伊斯兰和穆斯林组织发生冲突。双方后来达成互不侵犯协议，结束交战，使其能够协调未来针对马里军队及瓦格纳集团的袭击。

en.s: The 2024 WWE Hall of Fame was a professional wrestling event produced by WWE that featured the induction of the 25th class into the WWE Hall of Fame. The ceremony took place on April 5, 2024, at the Wells Fargo Center in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, the night preceding WrestleMania XL. It was livestreamed at 10 pm Eastern Time on Peacock in the United States and the WWE Network internationally, immediately after the airing of WWE's regular Friday night program, SmackDown.

zh.s: 2024年WWE名人堂典礼由WWE制作，表彰第25批入选成员。典礼于4月5日在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城富国银行中心举行，正值第四十届摔角狂热前一晚。美国东部时间晚上10点，周五常规节目《SmackDown》结束后，典礼立即通过美国Peacock平台及面向国际观众的WWE Network直播。

en.s: The Progress Chapter 166: Freedom Walks Again was a professional wrestling event produced by Progress Wrestling. It took place on April 5, 2024, in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania at the Penns Landing Caterers. The event was broadcast live on Triller TV and also featured wrestlers from Game Changer Wrestling (GCW) and was held in conjunction with the Collective.

zh.s: “Progress第166章：自由再度前行”是Progress摔角联盟制作的职业摔角赛事，于2024年4月5日在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城Penns Landing Caterers场馆举行。赛事由Triller TV直播，也有GCW联盟选手参加，并作为Collective系列活动的一部分举办。

en.t: 2024 raid on the Mexican embassy in Quito
en.s: On 5 April 2024, the Mexican embassy in Quito was raided by Ecuadorian police and military forces. Mexico and numerous other countries decried the raid as a violation of the 1961 Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations and the 1954 Caracas Convention on Diplomatic Asylum. The raid was carried out to arrest the former vice president of Ecuador, Jorge Glas, who had been sentenced for corruption and had been living in the embassy since 17 December 2023.

zh.t: 2024年厄瓜多尔强闯墨西哥驻基多大使馆
zh.s: 2024年4月5日，厄瓜多尔警察和军队强行进入墨西哥驻基多大使馆。墨西哥及许多其他国家谴责此举违反1961年《维也纳外交关系公约》和1954年《加拉加斯外交庇护公约》。行动目的是逮捕厄瓜多尔前副总统豪尔赫·格拉斯。他曾因腐败被判刑，自2023年12月17日起一直住在大使馆内。

en.s: Battle Riot VII was a professional wrestling live streaming event event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW), which took place on April 5, 2025, at Thunder Studios Arena in Long Beach, California. It was the seventh event under the Battle Riot chronology.

zh.s: 第七届“战斗暴乱”是职业摔角大联盟（MLW）制作的职业摔角网络直播赛事，于2025年4月5日在美国加利福尼亚州长滩雷霆影棚竞技场举行。

en.t: UFC on ESPN: Emmett vs. Murphy
en.s: UFC on ESPN: Emmett vs. Murphy (also known as UFC on ESPN 65 and UFC Vegas 105) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on April 5, 2025, at the UFC Apex in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.

zh.t: UFC ESPN赛事：埃米特对墨菲
zh.s: UFC ESPN赛事：埃米特对墨菲，又称UFC ESPN赛事65及UFC拉斯维加斯105，是终极格斗冠军赛于2025年4月5日，在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯UFC Apex场馆举办的综合格斗赛事。恩特普赖斯位于拉斯维加斯谷地。

en.s: A by-election was held on April 5, 2025, in Vancouver, British Columbia, to fill two vacant seats on Vancouver City Council, following the resignations of Christine Boyle and Adriane Carr. The by-election was notable due to record voter turnout for a Vancouver municipal by-election. In a rebuke of incumbent mayor Ken Sim's ABC Vancouver, the two vacant seats were won by progressive candidates.

zh.s: 2025年4月5日，加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华举行补选，填补温哥华市议会的两个空缺席位。空缺由克里斯汀·博伊尔和阿德里安·卡尔辞职造成。这次补选的投票率创温哥华市政补选纪录。选举结果也被视为对现任市长肯·西姆所属的ABC温哥华的反对：两个空缺席位均由进步派候选人赢得。

en.s: ONE Fight Night 30: Kryklia vs. Knowles was a combat sports event produced by ONE Championship that took place on April 5, 2025, at Lumpinee Boxing Stadium in Bangkok, Thailand.

zh.s: ONE格斗之夜30：克里克利亚对阵诺尔斯是由ONE冠军赛主办的格斗赛事，于2025年4月5日在泰国曼谷伦披尼拳击场举行。
